1.1.s: agna ā yāhi vītaye gr̥ṇāno havyadātaye ni hotā satsi barhiṣi
1.1.d: अग्न आ याहि वीतये गृणानो हव्यदातये नि होता सत्सि बर्हिषि
1.1.e: Come, Agni, praised with song, to feast and sacrificial offering: sit As Hotar on the holy grass!

1.1.s: tvamagne yajñānām̐ hotā viśveṣām̐ hitaḥ devebʰirmānuṣe jane
1.1.d: त्वमग्ने यज्ञानाꣳ होता विश्वेषाꣳ हितः देवेभिर्मानुषे जने
1.1.e: O Agni, thou hast been ordained Hotar of every sacrifice, By Gods, among the race of men.

1.1.s: agniṃ dūtaṃ vr̥ṇīmahe hotāraṃ viśvavedasam asya yajñasya sukratum
1.1.d: अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसम् अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम्
1.1.e: Agni we choose as envoy, skilled performer of this holy rite, Hotar, possessor of all wealth.
Served with oblation, kindled, bright, through love of song may Agni, bent On riches, smite the Vritras dead!

1.1.s: preṣṭʰaṃ vo atitʰim̐ stuṣe mitramiva priyam agne ratʰaṃ na vedyam
1.1.d: प्रेष्ठं वो अतिथिꣳ स्तुषे मित्रमिव प्रियम् अग्ने रथं न वेद्यम्
1.1.e: I laud your most beloved guest like a dear friend, O Agni, him Who, like a chariot, wins us wealth.

1.1.s: tvaṃ no agne mahobʰiḥ pāhi viśvasyā arāteḥ uta dviṣo martyasya
1.1.d: त्वं नो अग्ने महोभिः पाहि विश्वस्या अरातेः उत द्विषो मर्त्यस्य
1.1.e: Do thou, O Agni, with great might guard us from all malignity, Yea, from the hate of mortal man!

1.1.s: ehyū ṣu bravāṇi te 'gna ittʰetarā giraḥ ebʰirvardʰāsa indubʰiḥ
1.1.d: एह्यू षु ब्रवाणि ते ऽग्न इत्थेतरा गिरः एभिर्वर्धास इन्दुभिः
1.1.e: O Agni, come; far other songs of praise will I sing forth to thee. Wax mighty with these Soma-drops!

1.1.s: ā te vatso mano yamatparamāccitsadʰastʰāt agne tvāṃ kāmaye girā
1.1.d: आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत्परमाच्चित्सधस्थात् अग्ने त्वां कामये गिरा
1.1.e: May Vatsa draw thy mind away even from thy loftiest dwelling place! Agni, I yearn for thee with song.

1.1.s: tvāmagne puṣkarādadʰyatʰarvā niramantʰata mūrdʰno viśvasya vāgʰataḥ
1.1.d: त्वामग्ने पुष्करादध्यथर्वा निरमन्थत मूर्ध्नो विश्वस्य वाघतः
1.1.e: Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the sky, the head Of all who offer sacrifice.

1.2.s: agne vivasvadā bʰarāsmabʰyamūtaye mahe devo hyasi no dr̥śe
1.2.d: अग्ने विवस्वदा भरास्मभ्यमूतये महे देवो ह्यसि नो दृशे
1.2.e: O Agni, bring us radiant light to be our mighty succour, for Thou art our visible deity!

1.2.s: namaste agna ojase gr̥ṇanti deva kr̥ṣṭayaḥ amairamitramardaya
1.2.d: नमस्ते अग्न ओजसे गृणन्ति देव कृष्टयः अमैरमित्रमर्दय
1.2.e: O Agni, God, the people sing reverent praise to thee for strength: With terrors trouble thou the foe

1.2.s: dūtaṃ vo viśvavedasam̐ havyavāhamamartyam yajiṣṭʰamr̥ñjase girā
1.2.d: दूतं वो विश्ववेदसꣳ हव्यवाहममर्त्यम् यजिष्ठमृञ्जसे गिरा
1.2.e: I seek with song your messenger, oblation-bearer, lord of wealth, Immortal, best at sacrifice.

1.2.s: upa tvā jāmayo giro dediśatīrhaviṣkr̥taḥ vāyoranīke astʰiran
1.2.d: उप त्वा जामयो गिरो देदिशतीर्हविष्कृतः वायोरनीके अस्थिरन्
1.2.e: Still turning to their aim in thee the sacrificer's sister hymns Have come to thee before the wind.

1.2.s: upa tvāgne divedive doṣāvastardʰiyā vayam namo bʰaranta emasi
1.2.d: उप त्वाग्ने दिवेदिवे दोषावस्तर्धिया वयम् नमो भरन्त एमसि
1.2.e: To thee, illuminer of night, O Agni, day by day with prayer, Bringing thee reverence, we come.

1.2.s: jarābodʰa tadviviḍḍʰi viśeviśe yajñiyāya stomam̐ rudrāya dr̥śīkam
1.2.d: जराबोध तद्विविड्ढि विशेविशे यज्ञियाय स्तोमꣳ रुद्राय दृशीकम्
1.2.e: Help, thou who knowest lauds, this work, a lovely hymn in Rudra's praise, Adorable in every house!

1.2.s: prati tyaṃ cārumadʰvaraṃ gopītʰāya pra hūyase marudbʰiragna ā gahi
1.2.d: प्रति त्यं चारुमध्वरं गोपीथाय प्र हूयसे मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि
1.2.e: To this fair sacrifice to drink the milky draught art thou called forth: O Agni, with the Maruts come!

1.2.s: aśvaṃ na tvā vāravantaṃ vandadʰyā agniṃ namobʰiḥ samrājantamadʰvarāṇām
1.2.d: अश्वं न त्वा वारवन्तं वन्दध्या अग्निं नमोभिः सम्राजन्तमध्वराणाम्
1.2.e: With homage will I reverence thee, Agni, like a long-tailed steed, Imperial lord of holy rites.
As Aurva and as Bhrigu called, as Apnavana called, I call The radiant Agni robed with sea.

1.2.s: agnimindʰāno manasā dʰiyam̐ saceta martyaḥ agnimindʰe vivasvabʰiḥ
1.2.d: अग्निमिन्धानो मनसा धियꣳ सचेत मर्त्यः अग्निमिन्धे विवस्वभिः
1.2.e: When he enkindles Agni, man should with his heart attend the song: I kindle Agni till he glows.

1.3.s: āditpratnasya retaso jyotiḥ paśyanti vāsaram paro yadidʰyate divi
1.3.d: आदित्प्रत्नस्य रेतसो ज्योतिः पश्यन्ति वासरम् परो यदिध्यते दिवि
1.3.e: Then, verily, they see the light refulgent of primeval seed, Kindled on yonder side of heaven.

1.3.s: agniṃ vo vr̥dʰantamadʰvarāṇāṃ purūtamam accʰā naptre sahasvate
1.3.d: अग्निं वो वृधन्तमध्वराणां पुरूतमम् अच्छा नप्त्रे सहस्वते
1.3.e: Hither, for powerful kinship, I call Agni, him who prospers you, Most frequent at our solemn rites.

1.3.s: agnistigmena śociṣā yam̐sadviśvaṃ nyā3triṇam agnirno vam̐sate rayim
1.3.d: अग्निस्तिग्मेन शोचिषा यꣳसद्विश्वं न्या३त्रिणम् अग्निर्नो वꣳसते रयिम्
1.3.e: May Agni with his pointed blaze cast down each fierce devouring fiend: May Agni win us wealth by war!

1.3.s: agne mr̥ḍa mahām̐ asyaya ā devayuṃ janam iyetʰa barhirāsadam
1.3.d: अग्ने मृड महाꣳ अस्यय आ देवयुं जनम् इयेथ बर्हिरासदम्
1.3.e: Agni, be gracious; thou art great: thou hast approached the pious man, Hast come to sit on sacred grass.

1.3.s: agne rakṣā ṇo am̐hasaḥ prati sma deva rīṣataḥ tapiṣṭʰairajaro daha
1.3.d: अग्ने रक्षा णो अꣳहसः प्रति स्म देव रीषतः तपिष्ठैरजरो दह
1.3.e: Agni, preserve us,from distress consume our enemies, O God, Eternal, with thy hottest flames

1.3.s: agne yuṅkṣvā hi ye tavāśvāso deva sādʰavaḥ araṃ vahantyāśavaḥ
1.3.d: अग्ने युङ्क्ष्वा हि ये तवाश्वासो देव साधवः अरं वहन्त्याशवः
1.3.e: Harness, O Agni, O thou God, thy steeds which are most excellent! The fleet ones bring thee rapidly.

1.3.s: ni tvā nakṣya viśpate dyumantaṃ dʰīmahe vayam suvīramagna āhuta
1.3.d: नि त्वा नक्ष्य विश्पते द्युमन्तं धीमहे वयम् सुवीरमग्न आहुत
1.3.e: Lord of the tribes, whom all must seek, we worshipped Agni set thee down, Refulgent, rich in valiant men.

1.3.s: agnirmūrdʰā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pr̥tʰivyā ayam apām̐ retām̐si jinvati
1.3.d: अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत्पतिः पृथिव्या अयम् अपाꣳ रेताꣳसि जिन्वति
1.3.e: Agni is head and height of heaven, the master of the earth is he He quickeneth the waters' seed.

1.3.s: imamū ṣu tvamasmākam̐ saniṃ gāyatraṃ navyām̐sam agne deveṣu pra vocaḥ
1.3.d: इममू षु त्वमस्माकꣳ सनिं गायत्रं नव्याꣳसम् अग्ने देवेषु प्र वोचः
1.3.e: O Agni, graciously announce this our good fortune of the Gods, And this our newest hymn of praise! 9, By song, O Agni, Angiras! Gopavana hath brought thee forth Hear thou my call, refulgent one!

1.3.s: taṃ tvā gopavano girā janiṣṭʰadagne aṅgaraḥ sa pāvaka śrudʰī havam
1.3.d: तं त्वा गोपवनो गिरा जनिष्ठदग्ने अङ्गरः स पावक श्रुधी हवम्
1.3.e: Agni, the Sage, the Lord of Strength, hath moved around the sacred gifts, Giving the offerer precious things.

His heralds bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, The Sun, that all may look on him. 12, Praise Agni in the sacrifice, the Sage whose holy laws are true The God who driveth grief away.

1.3.s: udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ dr̥śe viśvāya sūryam
1.3.d: उदु त्यं जातवेदसं देवं वहन्ति केतवः दृशे विश्वाय सूर्यम्
1.3.e: Kind be the Goddesses to lend us help, and kind that we may drink: May their streams bring us health and wealth

1.4.e: Lord of the brave, whose songs dost thou in thine abundance now inspire, Thou whose hymns help to win the kine?

1.4.s: śaṃ no devīrabʰiṣṭaye śaṃ no bʰavantu pītaye śaṃ yorabʰi sravantu naḥ
1.4.d: शं नो देवीरभिष्टये शं नो भवन्तु पीतये शं योरभि स्रवन्तु नः
1.4.e: Sing to your Agni with each song, at every sacrifice for strength. Come, let us praise the wise and, everlasting God even as a well-beloved friend,

1.4.s: kasya nūnaṃ parīṇasi dʰiyo jinvasi satpate joṣātā yasya te giraḥ
1.4.d: कस्य नूनं परीणसि धियो जिन्वसि सत्पते जोषाता यस्य ते गिरः
1.4.e: Agni, protect thou us by one, protect us by the second song, Protect us by three hymns, O Lord of power and might, bright God, by four hymns guard us well!

1.4.s: yajñāyajñā vo agnaye girāgirā ca dakṣase prapra vayamamr̥taṃ jātavedasaṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śam̐siṣam
1.4.d: यज्ञायज्ञा वो अग्नये गिरागिरा च दक्षसे प्रप्र वयममृतं जातवेदसं प्रियं मित्रं न शꣳसिषम्
1.4.e: O Agni, with thy lofty beams, with thy pure brilliancy, O God, Kindled, most youthful one! by Bharadvaja's hand, shine on us richly, holy Lord!

1.4.s: pāhi no agna ekayā pāhyū3ta dvitīyayā pāhi gīrbʰistisr̥bʰirūrjāṃ pate pāhi catasr̥bʰirvaso
1.4.d: पाहि नो अग्न एकया पाह्यू३त द्वितीयया पाहि गीर्भिस्तिसृभिरूर्जां पते पाहि चतसृभिर्वसो
1.4.e: O Agni who art worshipped well, dear let our princes be to thee, Our wealthy patrons who are governors of men, who part, as gifts, the stall of kine!

1.4.s: br̥hadbʰiragne arcibʰiḥ śukreṇa deva śociṣā bʰaradvāje samidʰāno yaviṣṭʰya revatpāvaka dīdihi
1.4.d: बृहद्भिरग्ने अर्चिभिः शुक्रेण देव शोचिषा भरद्वाजे समिधानो यविष्ठ्य रेवत्पावक दीदिहि
1.4.e: Agni, praise-singer! Lord of men, God! burning up the Rakshasas, Mighty art thou, the ever-present, household-lord! home-friend and guardian from the sky.

1.4.s: tve agne svāhuta priyāsaḥ santu sūrayaḥ yantāro ye magʰavāno janānāmūrvaṃ dayanta gonām
1.4.d: त्वे अग्ने स्वाहुत प्रियासः सन्तु सूरयः यन्तारो ये मघवानो जनानामूर्वं दयन्त गोनाम्
1.4.e: Immortal Jatavedas, thou bright-hued refulgent gift of Dawn, Agni, this day to him who pays oblations bring the Gods who waken with the morn!

1.4.s: agne jaritarviśpatistapāno deva rakṣasaḥ aproṣivāngr̥hapate mahām̐ asi divaspāyurduroṇayuḥ
1.4.d: अग्ने जरितर्विश्पतिस्तपानो देव रक्षसः अप्रोषिवान्गृहपते महाꣳ असि दिवस्पायुर्दुरोणयुः
1.4.e: Wonderful, with thy favouring help, send us thy bounties, gracious Lord. Thou art the charioteer, Agni, of earthly wealth: find rest and safety for our seed!

1.4.s: agne vivasvaduṣasaścitram̐ rādʰo amartya ā dāśuṣe jātavedo vahā tvamadyā devām̐ uṣarbudʰaḥ
1.4.d: अग्ने विवस्वदुषसश्चित्रꣳ राधो अमर्त्य आ दाशुषे जातवेदो वहा त्वमद्या देवाꣳ उषर्बुधः
1.4.e: Famed art thou, Agni, far and wide, preserver, righteous, and a Sage. The holy singers, O enkindled radiant one, ordainers, call on thee to come.

1.4.s: tvaṃ naścitra ūtyā vaso rādʰām̐si codaya asya rāyastvamagne ratʰīrasi vidā gādʰaṃ tuce tu naḥ
1.4.d: त्वं नश्चित्र ऊत्या वसो राधाꣳसि चोदय अस्य रायस्त्वमग्ने रथीरसि विदा गाधं तुचे तु नः
1.4.e: O holy Agni, give us wealth famed among men and strengthening life! Bestow on us, O helper, that which many crave, more glorious still through righteousness!

1.5.s: tvamitsapratʰā asyagne trātarr̥taḥ kaviḥ tvāṃ viprāsaḥ samidʰāna dīdiva ā vivāsanti vedʰasaḥ
1.5.d: त्वमित्सप्रथा अस्यग्ने त्रातरृतः कविः त्वां विप्रासः समिधान दीदिव आ विवासन्ति वेधसः
1.5.e: To him, who dealeth out all wealth, the sweet-toned Hotar-priest of men, To him like the first vessels filled with savoury juice, to Agni let the lauds go forth.

1.5.s: ā no agne vayovr̥dʰam̐ rayiṃ pāvaka śam̐syam rāsvā ca na upamāte puruspr̥ham̐ sunītī suyaśastaram
1.5.d: आ नो अग्ने वयोवृधꣳ रयिं पावक शꣳस्यम् रास्वा च न उपमाते पुरुस्पृहꣳ सुनीती सुयशस्तरम्
1.5.e: With this mine homage I invoke Agni for you, the Son of Strength, Dear, wisest envoy, skilled in noble sacrifice, immortal messenger of all.

1.5.s: yo viśvā dayate vasu hotā mandro janānām madʰorna pātrā pratʰamānyasmai pra stomā yantvagnaye
1.5.d: यो विश्वा दयते वसु होता मन्द्रो जनानाम् मधोर्न पात्रा प्रथमान्यस्मै प्र स्तोमा यन्त्वग्नये
1.5.e: Thou liest in the logs that are thy mothers: mortals kindle thee. Alert thou bearest off the sacrifleer's gift, and then thou shinest to the Gods.

1.5.s: enā vo agniṃ namasorjo napātamā huve priyaṃ cetiṣṭʰamaratim̐ svādʰvaraṃ viśvasya dūtamamr̥tam
1.5.d: एना वो अग्निं नमसोर्जो नपातमा हुवे प्रियं चेतिष्ठमरतिꣳ स्वाध्वरं विश्वस्य दूतममृतम्
1.5.e: He hath appeared, best prosperer, in whom men lay their holy acts: So may our songs of praise come nigh to Agni who was born to give the Arya strength!

1.5.s: śeṣe vaneṣu mātr̥ṣu saṃ tvā martāsa indʰate atandro havyaṃ vahasi haviṣkr̥ta ādiddeveṣu rājasi
1.5.d: शेषे वनेषु मातृषु सं त्वा मर्तास इन्धते अतन्द्रो हव्यं वहसि हविष्कृत आदिद्देवेषु राजसि
1.5.e: Chief Priest is Agni at the laud, as stones and grass at sacrifice. Gods! Maruts! Brahmanaspati! I crave with song the help that is most excellent.

1.5.s: adarśi gātuvittamo yasminvratānyādadʰuḥ upo ṣu jātamāryasya vardʰanamagniṃ nakṣantu no giraḥ
1.5.d: अदर्शि गातुवित्तमो यस्मिन्व्रतान्यादधुः उपो षु जातमार्यस्य वर्धनमग्निं नक्षन्तु नो गिरः
1.5.e: Pray Agni of the piercing flame, with sacred songs, to be our help; For wealth, famed Agni, Purumilha and ye men! He is Suditi's sure defence.

1.5.s: agniruktʰe purohito grāvāṇo barhiradʰvare r̥cā yāmi maruto brahmaṇaspate devā avo vareṇyam
1.5.d: अग्निरुक्थे पुरोहितो ग्रावाणो बर्हिरध्वरे ऋचा यामि मरुतो ब्रह्मणस्पते देवा अवो वरेण्यम्
1.5.e: Hear, Agni who hast ears to hear, with all thy train of escort Gods! With those who come at dawn let Mitra, Aryaman sit on the grass at sacrifice.

1.5.s: agnimīḍiṣvāvase gātʰābʰiḥ śīraśociṣam agnim̐ rāye purumīḍʰa śrutaṃ naro 'gniḥ sudītaye cʰardiḥ
1.5.d: अग्निमीडिष्वावसे गाथाभिः शीरशोचिषम् अग्निꣳ राये पुरुमीढ श्रुतं नरो ऽग्निः सुदीतये छर्दिः
1.5.e: Agni of Divodasa, God, comes forth like Indra in his might. Rapidly hath he moved along his mother earth: he stands in high heaven's dwelling-place.

1.5.s: śrudʰi śrutkarṇa vahnibʰirdevairagne sayāvabʰiḥ ā sīdatu barhiṣi mitro aryamā prātaryāvabʰiradʰvare
1.5.d: श्रुधि श्रुत्कर्ण वह्निभिर्देवैरग्ने सयावभिः आ सीदतु बर्हिषि मित्रो अर्यमा प्रातर्यावभिरध्वरे
1.5.e: Whether thou come from earth or from the lofty lucid realm of heaven, Wax stronger in thy body through my song of praise: fill full all creatures, O most wise!

1.5.s: pra daivodāso agnirdeva indro na majmanā anu mātaraṃ pr̥tʰivīṃ vi vāvr̥te tastʰau nākasya śarmaṇi
1.5.d: प्र दैवोदासो अग्निर्देव इन्द्रो न मज्मना अनु मातरं पृथिवीं वि वावृते तस्थौ नाकस्य शर्मणि
1.5.e: If, loving well the forests, thou wentest to thy maternal floods, Not to be scorned, Agni, is that return of thine when, from afar, thou now art here.

1.6.s: adʰa jmo adʰa vā divo br̥hato rocanādadʰi ayā vardʰasva tanvā girā mamā jātā sukrato pr̥ṇa
1.6.d: अध ज्मो अध वा दिवो बृहतो रोचनादधि अया वर्धस्व तन्वा गिरा ममा जाता सुक्रतो पृण
1.6.e: O Agni, Manu stablished thee a light for all the race of men: With Kanva hast thou blazed, Law-born and waxen strong, thou whom the people reverence.

1.6.s: kāyamāno vanā tvaṃ yanmātr̥̄rajagannapaḥ na tatte agne pramr̥ṣe nivartanaṃ yaddūre sannihābʰuvaḥ
1.6.d: कायमानो वना त्वं यन्मातॄरजगन्नपः न तत्ते अग्ने प्रमृषे निवर्तनं यद्दूरे सन्निहाभुवः
1.6.e: The God who giveth wealth accept your full libation poured to, him! Pour ye it out, then fill the vessel full again, for so the God regardeth you.

1.6.s: ni tvāmagne manurdadʰe jyotirjanāya śaśvate dīdetʰa kaṇva r̥tajāta ukṣito yaṃ namasyanti kr̥ṣṭayaḥ
1.6.d: नि त्वामग्ने मनुर्दधे ज्योतिर्जनाय शश्वते दीदेथ कण्व ऋतजात उक्षितो यं नमस्यन्ति कृष्टयः
1.6.e: Let Brahmanaspati come forth, let Sunrita the Goddess come, And Gods bring to our rite which yields a fivefold gift the hero, lover of mankind!

1.6.s: devo vo draviṇodāḥ pūrṇāṃ vivaṣṭvāsicam udvā siñjadʰvamupa vā pr̥ṇadʰvamādidvo deva ohate
1.6.d: देवो वो द्रविणोदाः पूर्णां विवष्ट्वासिचम् उद्वा सिञ्जध्वमुप वा पृणध्वमादिद्वो देव ओहते
1.6.e: Stand up erect to lend us aid, stand up like Savitar the God, Erect as strength-bestower when we call on thee with priests who balm our offerings!

1.6.s: praitu brahmaṇaspatiḥ pra devyetu sūnr̥tā accʰā vīraṃ naryaṃ paṅktirādʰasaṃ devā yajñaṃ nayantu naḥ
1.6.d: प्रैतु ब्रह्मणस्पतिः प्र देव्येतु सूनृता अच्छा वीरं नर्यं पङ्क्तिराधसं देवा यज्ञं नयन्तु नः
1.6.e: The man who bringeth gifts to thee, bright God who fain wouldst lead to wealth, Winneth himself a brave son, Agni! skilled in lauds, one prospering in a thousand ways.

1.6.s: ūrdʰva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye tiṣṭʰā devo na savitā ūrdʰvo vājasya sanitā yadañjibʰirvāgʰadbʰirvihvayāmahe
1.6.d: ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु ण ऊतये तिष्ठा देवो न सविता ऊर्ध्वो वाजस्य सनिता यदञ्जिभिर्वाघद्भिर्विह्वयामहे
1.6.e: With hymns and holy eulogies we supplicate your Agni, Lord Of many families who duly serve the Gods, yea, him whom others too inflame.

1.6.s: pra yo rāye ninīṣati marto yaste vaso dāśat sa vīraṃ dʰatte agna uktʰaśam̐sinaṃ tmanā sahasrapoṣiṇam
1.6.d: प्र यो राये निनीषति मर्तो यस्ते वसो दाशत् स वीरं धत्ते अग्न उक्थशꣳसिनं त्मना सहस्रपोषिणम्
1.6.e: This Agni is the Lord of great prosperity and hero, strength, Of wealth with noble offspring and with store of kine, the Lord of battles with the foe.

1.6.s: pra vo yahvaṃ purūṇāṃ viśāṃ devayatīnām agnim̐ sūktebʰirvacobʰirvr̥ṇīmahe yam̐samidanya indʰate
1.6.d: प्र वो यह्वं पुरूणां विशां देवयतीनाम् अग्निꣳ सूक्तेभिर्वचोभिर्वृणीमहे यꣳसमिदन्य इन्धते
1.6.e: Thou, Agni, art the homestead's Lord, our Hotar-priest at sacrifice. Lord of all boons, thou art the Potar, passing wise. Pay worship, and enjoy the good!

1.7.s: ayamagniḥ suvīryasyeśe hi saubʰagasya rāya īśe svapatyasya gomata īśe vr̥trahatʰānām
1.7.d: अयमग्निः सुवीर्यस्येशे हि सौभगस्य राय ईशे स्वपत्यस्य गोमत ईशे वृत्रहथानाम्
1.7.e: We as thy friends have chosen thee, mortals a God, to be our help. The Waters' Child, the blessed, the most mighty one, swift conqueror, and without a peer.

1.7.s: tvamagne gr̥hapatistvam̐ hotā no adʰvare tvaṃ potā viśvavāra pracetā tākṣi yāsi ca vāryam
1.7.d: त्वमग्ने गृहपतिस्त्वꣳ होता नो अध्वरे त्वं पोता विश्ववार प्रचेता ताक्षि यासि च वार्यम्
1.7.e: Present oblations, make him splendid: set ye as Hotar in his place the Home's Lord, worshipped With gifts and homage where they pour libations! Honour him meet for reverence in our houses.

1.7.s: sakʰāyastvā vavr̥mahe devaṃ martāsa ūtaye apāṃ napātam̐ subʰagam̐ sudam̐sasam̐ supratūrtimanehasam
1.7.d: सखायस्त्वा ववृमहे देवं मर्तास ऊतये अपां नपातꣳ सुभगꣳ सुदꣳससꣳ सुप्रतूर्तिमनेहसम्
1.7.e: Verily wondrous is the tender youngling's growth who never draweth nigh to drink his mother's milk. As soon as she who hath no udder bore him, he, faring on his. great errand, suddenly grew strong.

1.7.s: ā juhotā haviṣā marjayadʰvaṃ ni hotāraṃ gr̥hapatiṃ dadʰidʰvam iḍaspade namasā rātahavyam̐ saparyatā yajataṃ pastyānām
1.7.d: आ जुहोता हविषा मर्जयध्वं नि होतारं गृहपतिं दधिध्वम् इडस्पदे नमसा रातहव्यꣳ सपर्यता यजतं पस्त्यानाम्
1.7.e: Here is one light for thee, another yonder: enter the third and, be therewith united. Beautiful be thy union with the body, beloved in the Gods' sublimest birthplace!

1.7.s: citra iccʰiśostaruṇasya vakṣatʰo na yo mātarāvanveti dʰātave anūdʰā yadajījanadadʰā cidā vavakṣatsadyo mahi dūtyā3ṃ caran
1.7.d: चित्र इच्छिशोस्तरुणस्य वक्षथो न यो मातरावन्वेति धातवे अनूधा यदजीजनदधा चिदा ववक्षत्सद्यो महि दूत्या३ं चरन्
1.7.e: For Jatavedas, worthy of our praise, will we frame with our mind this eulogy as 'twere a car; For good, in his assembly, is this care of ours. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm!

1.7.s: idaṃ ta ekaṃ para ū ta ekaṃ tr̥tīyena jyotiṣā saṃ viśasva saṃveśanastanve3 cāruredʰi priyo devānāṃ parame janitre
1.7.d: इदं त एकं पर ऊ त एकं तृतीयेन ज्योतिषा सं विशस्व संवेशनस्तन्वे३ चारुरेधि प्रियो देवानां परमे जनित्रे
1.7.e: Agni Vaisvanara, born in course of Order, the messenger of earth, the head of heaven, The Sage, the sovran, guest of men, our vessel fit for their mouth, the Gods have generated.

1.7.s: imam̐ stomamarhate jātavedase ratʰamiva saṃ mahemā manīṣayā bʰadrā hi naḥ pramatirasya sam̐sadyagne sakʰye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
1.7.d: इमꣳ स्तोममर्हते जातवेदसे रथमिव सं महेमा मनीषया भद्रा हि नः प्रमतिरस्य सꣳसद्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव
1.7.e: Even as the waters from the mountain ridges, so sprang the; Gods, through lauds, from thee, O Agni. To thee speed hymns and eulogies, as horses haste, bearing him who loves the song, to battle.

1.7.s: mūrdʰānaṃ divo aratiṃ pr̥tʰivyā vaiśvānaramr̥ta ā jātamagnim kavim̐ samrājamatitʰiṃ janānāmāsannāḥ pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ
1.7.d: मूर्धानं दिवो अरतिं पृथिव्या वैश्वानरमृत आ जातमग्निम् कविꣳ सम्राजमतिथिं जनानामासन्नाः पात्रं जनयन्त देवाः
1.7.e: Win to protect you, Rudra, lord of worship, priest of both worlds, effectual sacrificer, Agni, invested with his golden colours, before the thunder strike and lay you senseless!

1.7.s: vi tvadāpo na parvatasya pr̥ṣṭʰāduktʰebʰiragne janayanta devāḥ taṃ tvā giraḥ suṣṭutayo vājayantyājiṃ na girvavāho jigyuraśvāḥ
1.7.d: वि त्वदापो न पर्वतस्य पृष्ठादुक्थेभिरग्ने जनयन्त देवाः तं त्वा गिरः सुष्टुतयो वाजयन्त्याजिं न गिर्ववाहो जिग्युरश्वाः
1.7.e: The King whose face is decked with oil is kindled with homage offered by his faithful servant. The men, the priests adore him with oblations. Agni hath shone forth at the flush of morning.

1.7.s: ā vo rājānamadʰvarasya rudram̐ hotāram̐ satyayajam̐ rodasyoḥ agniṃ purā tanayitnoracittāddʰiraṇyarūpamavase kr̥ṇudʰvam
1.7.d: आ वो राजानमध्वरस्य रुद्रꣳ होतारꣳ सत्ययजꣳ रोदस्योः अग्निं पुरा तनयित्नोरचित्ताद्धिरण्यरूपमवसे कृणुध्वम्
1.7.e: Agni advanceth with his lofty banner: through earth and heaven the Bull hath loudly bellowed He hath come nigh from the sky's farthest limit: the Steer hath waxen in the waters' bosom.

1.8.s: indʰe rājā samaryo namobʰiryasya pratīkamāhutaṃ gʰr̥tena naro havyebʰirīḍate sabādʰa āgniragramuṣasāmaśoci
1.8.d: इन्धे राजा समर्यो नमोभिर्यस्य प्रतीकमाहुतं घृतेन नरो हव्येभिरीडते सबाध आग्निरग्रमुषसामशोचि
1.8.e: From the two fire-sticks have the men engendered with thoughts, urged by the hand, the glorious Agni, Far-seen, with pointed flame, Lord of the Homestead.

1.8.s: pra ketunā br̥hatā yātyagnirā rodasī vr̥ṣabʰo roravīti divaścidantādupamāmudānaḍapāmupastʰe mahiṣo vavardʰa
1.8.d: प्र केतुना बृहता यात्यग्निरा रोदसी वृषभो रोरवीति दिवश्चिदन्तादुपमामुदानडपामुपस्थे महिषो ववर्ध
1.8.e: Agni is wakened by the people's fuel to meet the Dawn who cometh like a milch-cow. Like young trees shooting up on high their branches, his flames. are mounting to the vault of heaven.

1.8.s: agniṃ naro dīdʰitibʰiraṇyorhastacyutaṃ janayata praśastam dūredr̥śaṃ gr̥hapatimatʰavyum
1.8.d: अग्निं नरो दीधितिभिरण्योर्हस्तच्युतं जनयत प्रशस्तम् दूरेदृशं गृहपतिमथव्युम्
1.8.e: Set forth the gleaming one, the song-inspirer, not foolish with. the foolish, fort-destroyer, Who leadeth with his hymns to thought of conquest, gold-bearded, richly splendid with his armour

1.8.s: abodʰyagniḥ samidʰā janānāṃ prati dʰenumivāyatīmuṣāsam yahvā iva pra vayāmujjihānāḥ pra bʰānavaḥ sasrate nākamaccʰa
1.8.d: अबोध्यग्निः समिधा जनानां प्रति धेनुमिवायतीमुषासम् यह्वा इव प्र वयामुज्जिहानाः प्र भानवः सस्रते नाकमच्छ
1.8.e: Thou art like heaven: one form is bright, one holy, like Day and Night dissimilar in colour. All magic powers thou aidest, self-dependent! Auspicious bethy bounty here, O Pushan!

1.8.s: pra bʰūrjayantaṃ mahāṃ vipodʰāṃ mūrairamūraṃ purāṃ darmāṇam nayantaṃ gīrbʰirvanā dʰiyaṃ dʰā hariśmaśruṃ na vārmaṇā dʰanarcim
1.8.d: प्र भूर्जयन्तं महां विपोधां मूरैरमूरं पुरां दर्माणम् नयन्तं गीर्भिर्वना धियं धा हरिश्मश्रुं न वार्मणा धनर्चिम्
1.8.e: As holy food, Agni, to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels! To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward!
Stablished to fill the juice with vital vigour, giver of wealth, guard of his servant's body, The great Priest, born, who knows the clouds, abider with men, is seated in the waters' eddy.

1.8.s: śukraṃ te anyadyajataṃ te anyadviṣurūpe ahanī dyaurivāsi viśvā hi māyā avasi svadʰāvanbʰadrā te pūṣanniha rātirastu iḍāmagne purudam̐sam̐ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamam̐ havamānāya sādʰa syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatirbʰūtvasme
1.8.d: शुक्रं ते अन्यद्यजतं ते अन्यद्विषुरूपे अहनी द्यौरिवासि विश्वा हि माया अवसि स्वधावन्भद्रा ते पूषन्निह रातिरस्तु इडामग्ने पुरुदꣳसꣳ सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमꣳ हवमानाय साध स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे
1.8.e: Let the song, honouring the best, with longing honour the Asura's most famous sovran, The deeds of him the mighty, deeds like Indra's, the manly one in whom the folk must triumph!

1.8.s: pra hotā jāto mahānnabʰovinnr̥ṣadmā sīdadapāṃ vivarte dadʰadyo dʰāyī sute vayām̐si yantā vasūni vidʰate tanūpāḥ
1.8.d: प्र होता जातो महान्नभोविन्नृषद्मा सीददपां विवर्ते दधद्यो धायी सुते वयाꣳसि यन्ता वसूनि विधते तनूपाः
1.8.e: In the two kindling-blocks lies Jatavedas like the well-cherished germ in pregnant women,-- Agni who day by day must be entreated by men who watch provided with oblations.

1.9.s: pra samrājamasurasya praśstaṃ pum̐saḥ kr̥ṣṭīnāmanumādyasya indrasyeva pra tavasaskr̥tāni vandadvārā vandamānā vivaṣṭu
1.9.d: प्र सम्राजमसुरस्य प्रश्स्तं पुꣳसः कृष्टीनामनुमाद्यस्य इन्द्रस्येव प्र तवसस्कृतानि वन्दद्वारा वन्दमाना विवष्टु
1.9.e: Agni, from days of old thou slayest demons: never shall Rakshasas in fight o'ercome thee. Burn up the foolish ones, raw flesh devourers: let none of them escape thine heavenly arrow!

1.9.s: araṇyornihito jātavedā garbʰa ivetsubʰr̥to garbʰiṇībʰiḥ divediva īḍyo jāgr̥vadbʰirhaviṣmadbʰirmanuṣyebʰiragniḥ
1.9.d: अरण्योर्निहितो जातवेदा गर्भ इवेत्सुभृतो गर्भिणीभिः दिवेदिव ईड्यो जागृवद्भिर्हविष्मद्भिर्मनुष्येभिरग्निः
1.9.e: Bring us most mighty splendour thou, Agni, resistless on thy way: Prepare for us the path that leads to glorious opulence and strength!

1.9.s: sanādagne mr̥ṇasi yātudʰānānna tvā rakṣām̐si pr̥tanāsu jigyuḥ anu daha sahamūrānkayādo mā te hetyā mukṣata daivyāyāḥ
1.9.d: सनादग्ने मृणसि यातुधानान्न त्वा रक्षाꣳसि पृतनासु जिग्युः अनु दह सहमूरान्कयादो मा ते हेत्या मुक्षत दैव्यायाः
1.9.e: May the brave man, if full of zeal he serve and kindle Agni's flame, Duly presenting sacred gifts, enjoy the Gods' protecting help.

1.9.s: agna ojiṣṭʰamā bʰara dyumnamasmabʰyamadʰrigo pra no rāye panīyase ratsi vājāya pantʰām
1.9.d: अग्न ओजिष्ठमा भर द्युम्नमस्मभ्यमध्रिगो प्र नो राये पनीयसे रत्सि वाजाय पन्थाम्
1.9.e: Thy bright smoke lifts itself aloft, and far-extended shines in heaven, For, Purifier! like the Sun thou beamest with thy radiant glow.

1.9.s: yadi vīro anu ṣyādagnimindʰīta martyaḥ ājuhvaddʰavyamānuṣakśarma bʰakṣīta daivyam
1.9.d: यदि वीरो अनु ष्यादग्निमिन्धीत मर्त्यः आजुह्वद्धव्यमानुषक्शर्म भक्षीत दैव्यम्
1.9.e: Thou, Agni, even as Mitra, hast a princely glory of thine own. Bright, active God, thou makest fame increase like means of nourishment.

1.9.s: tveṣaste dʰūma r̥ṇvati divi saṃ ccʰukra ātataḥ sūro na hi dyutā tvaṃ kr̥pā pāvaka rocase
1.9.d: त्वेषस्ते धूम ऋण्वति दिवि सं च्छुक्र आततः सूरो न हि द्युता त्वं कृपा पावक रोचसे
1.9.e: At dawn let Agni, much-beloved, guest of the house, be glorified, In whom, the everlasting one, all mortals make their offerings blaze.

1.9.s: tvam̐ hi kṣaitavadyaśo 'gne mitro na patyase tvaṃ vicarṣaṇe śravo vaso puṣṭiṃ na puṣyasi
1.9.d: त्वꣳ हि क्षैतवद्यशो ऽग्ने मित्रो न पत्यसे त्वं विचर्षणे श्रवो वसो पुष्टिं न पुष्यसि
1.9.e: Most moving song be Agni's: shine on high, O rich in radiant light! Like the chief consort of a King riches and strength proceed from thee.

1.9.s: prātaragniḥ purupriyo viṣa stavetātitʰiḥ viśve yasminnamartye havyaṃ martāsa indʰate
1.9.d: प्रातरग्निः पुरुप्रियो विष स्तवेतातिथिः विश्वे यस्मिन्नमर्त्ये हव्यं मर्तास इन्धते
1.9.e: Exerting all our strength with thoughts of power we glorify in speech Agni your dear familiar friend, the darling guest in every house.

1.9.s: yadvāhiṣṭʰaṃ tadagnaye br̥hadarca vibʰāvaso mahiṣīva tvadrayistvadvājā udīrate
1.9.d: यद्वाहिष्ठं तदग्नये बृहदर्च विभावसो महिषीव त्वद्रयिस्त्वद्वाजा उदीरते
1.9.e: His beam hath lofty power of life: sing praise to Agni, to the God Whom men have set in foremost place, like Mitra for their eulogy!

1.9.s: viśoviśo vo atitʰiṃ vājayantaḥ purupriyam agniṃ vo duryaṃ vacaḥ stuṣe śūṣasya manmabʰiḥ
1.9.d: विशोविशो वो अतिथिं वाजयन्तः पुरुप्रियम् अग्निं वो दुर्यं वचः स्तुषे शूषस्य मन्मभिः
1.9.e: To noblest Agni, friend of man, chief Vritra-slayer, have we come- Who with Srutarvan, Riksha's son, in lofty presence is inflamed.

1.10.s: br̥hadvayo hi bʰānave 'rcā devāyāgnaye yaṃ mitraṃ na praśastaye martāso dadʰire puraḥ
1.10.d: बृहद्वयो हि भानवे ऽर्चा देवायाग्नये यं मित्रं न प्रशस्तये मर्तासो दधिरे पुरः
1.10.e: Born as the loftiest Law commands, comrade of those who grew with him. Agni, the sire of Kasyapa by faith, the mother, Manu, Sage.

1.10.s: aganma vr̥trahantamaṃ jyeṣṭʰamagnimānavam ya sma śrutarvannārkṣe br̥hadanīka idʰyate
1.10.d: अगन्म वृत्रहन्तमं ज्येष्ठमग्निमानवम् य स्म श्रुतर्वन्नार्क्षे बृहदनीक इध्यते
1.10.e: We in King Soma place our trust, in Agni, and in Varuna, The Aditya, Vishnu, Surya, and the Brahman-priest Brihaspati.

1.10.s: jātaḥ pareṇa dʰarmaṇā yatsavr̥dbʰiḥ sahābʰuvaḥ pitā yatkaśyapasyāgniḥ śraddʰā mātā manuḥ kaviḥ
1.10.d: जातः परेण धर्मणा यत्सवृद्भिः सहाभुवः पिता यत्कश्यपस्याग्निः श्रद्धा माता मनुः कविः
1.10.e: Hence have these men gone up on high and mounted to the heights of heaven: On! conquer on the path by which Angirasas travelled to the skies!

1.10.s: somam̐ rājānaṃ varuṇamagnimanvārabʰāmahe ādityaṃ viṣṇum̐ sūryaṃ brahmānaṃ ca br̥haspatim
1.10.d: सोमꣳ राजानं वरुणमग्निमन्वारभामहे आदित्यं विष्णुꣳ सूर्यं ब्रह्मानं च बृहस्पतिम्
1.10.e: That thou mayst send us ample wealth, O Agni, we will kindler thee: So, for the great oblation, Steer, pray Heaven and Earth to come to us!

1.10.s: ita eta udāruhandivaḥ pr̥ṣṭʰānyā ruhan pra bʰūrjayo yatʰā patʰodyāmaṅgiraso yayuḥ
1.10.d: इत एत उदारुहन्दिवः पृष्ठान्या रुहन् प्र भूर्जयो यथा पथोद्यामङ्गिरसो ययुः
1.10.e: He runs when one calls after him, This is the prayer of him who prays. He holds all knowledge in his grasp even as the felly rounds the wheel.

1.10.s: rāye agne mahe tvā dānāya samidʰīmahi īḍiṣvā hi mahe vr̥ṣaṃ dyāvā hotrāya pr̥tʰivī
1.10.d: राये अग्ने महे त्वा दानाय समिधीमहि ईडिष्वा हि महे वृषं द्यावा होत्राय पृथिवी
1.10.e: Shoot forth, O Agni, with thy flame: demolish them on every side! Break down the Yatudhana's strength, the vigour of the Rakshasa!

2.1.s: dadʰanve vā yadīmanu vocadbrahmeti veru tat pari viśvāni kāvyā nemiścakramivābʰuvat
2.1.d: दधन्वे वा यदीमनु वोचद्ब्रह्मेति वेरु तत् परि विश्वानि काव्या नेमिश्चक्रमिवाभुवत्
2.1.e: Worship the Vasus, Agni! here, the Rudras and Adityas, all Who know fair sacrifices, sprung from Mann, scattering blessings down!

2.1.s: pratyagne harasā haraḥ śr̥ṇāhi viśvataspari yātudʰānasya rakṣaso balaṃ nyubjavīryam
2.1.d: प्रत्यग्ने हरसा हरः शृणाहि विश्वतस्परि यातुधानस्य रक्षसो बलं न्युब्जवीर्यम्
2.1.e: Agni, thy faithful servant I call upon thee with many a gift, As in the keeping of the great inciting God.

2.1.s: tvamagne vasūm̐riha rudrām̐ ādityām̐ uta yajā svadʰvaraṃ janaṃ manujātaṃ gʰr̥tapruṣam
2.1.d: त्वमग्ने वसूꣳरिह रुद्राꣳ आदित्याꣳ उत यजा स्वध्वरं जनं मनुजातं घृतप्रुषम्
2.1.e: To Agni, to the Hotar-priest offer your best, your lofty speech, To him ordainer-like who bears the light of songs.

2.1.s: puru tvā dāśivām̐ voce 'riragne tava svidā todasyeva śaraṇa ā mahasya
2.1.d: पुरु त्वा दाशिवाꣳ वोचे ऽरिरग्ने तव स्विदा तोदस्येव शरण आ महस्य
2.1.e: O Agni, thou who art the lord of wealth in kine, thou Son of Strength, Bestow on us, O Jatavedas, high renown

2.1.s: pra hotre pūrvyaṃ vaco 'gnaye bʰaratā br̥hat vipāṃ jyotīm̐ṣi bibʰrate na vedʰase
2.1.d: प्र होत्रे पूर्व्यं वचो ऽग्नये भरता बृहत् विपां ज्योतीꣳषि बिभ्रते न वेधसे
2.1.e: Most skilled in sacrifice, bring the Gods, O Agni, to the pious, man: A joyful Priest, thy splendour drives our foes afar

2.1.s: agne vājasya gomata īśānaḥ sahaso yaho asme dʰehi jātavedo mahi śravaḥ
2.1.d: अग्ने वाजस्य गोमत ईशानः सहसो यहो अस्मे धेहि जातवेदो महि श्रवः
2.1.e: Taught by seven mothers at his birth was he, for glory of the wise. He, firm and sure, hath set his mind on glorious wealth

2.1.s: agne yajiṣṭʰo adʰvare devāṃ devayate yaja hotā mandro vi rājasyati sridʰaḥ
2.1.d: अग्ने यजिष्ठो अध्वरे देवां देवयते यज होता मन्द्रो वि राजस्यति स्रिधः
2.1.e: And in the day our prayer is this: May Aditi come nigh to help, With loving-kindness bring us weal and chase our foes

2.1.s: jajñānaḥ sapta mātr̥bʰirmedʰāmāśāsata śriye ayaṃ dʰruvo rayīṇāṃ ciketadā
2.1.d: जज्ञानः सप्त मातृभिर्मेधामाशासत श्रिये अयं ध्रुवो रयीणां चिकेतदा
2.1.e: Worship thou Jatavedas, pray to him who willingly accepts, Whose smoke wanders at will, and none may grasp his flame

2.1.s: uta syā no divā matiraditirūtyāgamat sā śantātā mayaskaradapa sridʰaḥ
2.1.d: उत स्या नो दिवा मतिरदितिरूत्यागमत् सा शन्ताता मयस्करदप स्रिधः
2.1.e: No mortal man can e'er prevail by arts of magic over him Who hath served Agni well, the oblation-giving God.

2.1.s: īḍiṣvā hi pratīvyā3ṃ yajasva jātavedasam cariṣṇudʰūmamagr̥bʰītaśociṣam
2.1.d: ईडिष्वा हि प्रतीव्या३ं यजस्व जातवेदसम् चरिष्णुधूममगृभीतशोचिषम्
2.1.e: Agni, drive thou the wicked foe, the evil-hearted thief away, Far, far, Lord of the brave! and give us easy paths!

2.2.s: na tasya māyayā ca na ripurīśīta martyaḥ yo agnaye dadāśa havyadātaye
2.2.d: न तस्य मायया च न रिपुरीशीत मर्त्यः यो अग्नये ददाश हव्यदातये
2.2.e: O hero Agni, Lord of men, on hearing this new laud of mine Burn down the Rakshasas, enchanters, with thy flame!

2.2.s: apa tyaṃ vr̥jinam̐ ripum̐ stenamagne durādʰyam daviṣṭʰamasya satpate kr̥dʰī sugam
2.2.d: अप त्यं वृजिनꣳ रिपुꣳ स्तेनमग्ने दुराध्यम् दविष्ठमस्य सत्पते कृधी सुगम्
2.2.e: Sing forth to him the holy, most munificent, sublime with his refulgent glow, To Agni, ye Upastutas

2.2.s: śruṣṭyagne navasya me stomasya vīra viśpate ni māyinastapasā rakṣaso daha
2.2.d: श्रुष्ट्यग्ने नवस्य मे स्तोमस्य वीर विश्पते नि मायिनस्तपसा रक्षसो दह
2.2.e: Agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of valiant sons and does great deeds, Whose bond of friendship is thy choice

2.2.s: pra mam̐hiṣṭʰāya gāyata r̥tāvne br̥hate śukraśociṣe upastutāso agnaye
2.2.d: प्र मꣳहिष्ठाय गायत ऋताव्ने बृहते शुक्रशोचिषे उपस्तुतासो अग्नये
2.2.e: Sing praise to him the Lord of light! The Gods have made the God to be their messenger, To bear oblation to the Gods.

2.2.s: pra so agne tavotibʰiḥ suvīrābʰistarati vājakarmabʰiḥ yasya tvam̐ sakʰyamāvitʰa
2.2.d: प्र सो अग्ने तवोतिभिः सुवीराभिस्तरति वाजकर्मभिः यस्य त्वꣳ सख्यमाविथ
2.2.e: Anger not him who is our guest! He is the bright God Agni, praised by many a man, God Hotar, skilled in sacrifice.

2.2.s: taṃ gūrdʰayā svarṇaraṃ devāso devamaratiṃ dadʰanvire devatrā havyamūhiṣe
2.2.d: तं गूर्धया स्वर्णरं देवासो देवमरतिं दधन्विरे देवत्रा हव्यमूहिषे
2.2.e: May Agni, worshipped, bring us bliss: may the gift, blessed one! and sacrifice bring bliss. Yea, may our eulogies bring bliss.

2.2.s: mā no hr̥ṇītʰā atitʰiṃ vasuragniḥ purupraśasta eśaḥ yaḥ suhotā svadʰvaraḥ
2.2.d: मा नो हृणीथा अतिथिं वसुरग्निः पुरुप्रशस्त एशः यः सुहोता स्वध्वरः
2.2.e: Thee have we chosen skilfullest in sacrifice, immortal Priest among the Gods, Wise finisher of this holy rite.

2.2.s: bʰadro no agnirāhuto bʰadrā rātiḥ subʰaga bʰadro adʰvaraḥ bʰadrā uta praśastayaḥ
2.2.d: भद्रो नो अग्निराहुतो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः
2.2.e: Bring us that splendour, Agni, which may overcome each greedy fiend in our abode, And the malicious wrath of men!

2.3.s: yajiṣṭʰaṃ tvā vavr̥mahe devaṃ devatrā hotāramamartyam asya yajñasya sukratum
2.3.d: यजिष्ठं त्वा ववृमहे देवं देवत्रा होतारममर्त्यम् अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम्
2.3.e: Soon as the eager Lord of men is friendly unto Manu's race Agni averteth from us all the Rakshasas!

2.3.s: tadagne dyumnamā bʰara yatsāsāhā sadane kaṃ cidatriṇam manyuṃ janasya dūḍʰyam
2.3.d: तदग्ने द्युम्नमा भर यत्सासाहा सदने कं चिदत्रिणम् मन्युं जनस्य दूढ्यम्
2.3.e: Sing this, beside the flowing juice, to him your hero, much-invoked, To please him as a mighty Bull

2.3.s: yadvā u viśpatiḥ śitaḥ suprīto manuṣo viśe viśvedagniḥ prati rakṣām̐si sedʰati
2.3.d: यद्वा उ विश्पतिः शितः सुप्रीतो मनुषो विशे विश्वेदग्निः प्रति रक्षाꣳसि सेधति
2.3.e: O Satakratu Indra, now rejoice with that carouse of thine Which is most glorious of all!

2.3.s: tadvo gāya sute sacā puruhūtāya satvane śaṃ yadgave na śākine
2.3.d: तद्वो गाय सुते सचा पुरुहूताय सत्वने शं यद्गवे न शाकिने
2.3.e: Ye cows, protect the fount: the two mighty ones bless the sacrifice. The handles twain are wrought of gold.

2.3.s: yaste nūnam̐ śatakratavindra dyumnitamo madaḥ tena nūnaṃ made madeḥ
2.3.d: यस्ते नूनꣳ शतक्रतविन्द्र द्युम्नितमो मदः तेन नूनं मदे मदेः
2.3.e: Sing praises that the horse may come; sing, Srutakaksha, that the cow May come, that Indra's might may come

2.3.s: gāva upa vadāvaṭe mahi yajñasya rapsudā ubʰā karṇā hiraṇyayā
2.3.d: गाव उप वदावटे महि यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया
2.3.e: We make this Indra very strong to strike, the mighty Vritra dead: A vigorous hero shall he be.

2.3.s: aramaśvāya gāyata śrutakakṣāraṃ gave aramindrasya dʰāmne
2.3.d: अरमश्वाय गायत श्रुतकक्षारं गवे अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने
2.3.e: Based upon strength and victory and power, O Indra, is thy birth: Thou, mighty one! art strong indeed,

2.3.s: tamindraṃ vājayāmasi mahe vr̥trāya hantave sa vr̥ṣā vr̥ṣabʰo bʰuvat
2.3.d: तमिन्द्रं वाजयामसि महे वृत्राय हन्तवे स वृषा वृषभो भुवत्
2.3.e: The sacrifice made Indra great when he unrolled the earth, and made Himself a diadem in heaven.

2.3.s: tvamindra balādadʰi sahaso jāta ojasaḥ tvam̐ sanvr̥ṣanvr̥ṣedasi
2.3.d: त्वमिन्द्र बलादधि सहसो जात ओजसः त्वꣳ सन्वृषन्वृषेदसि
2.3.e: If I, O Indra, were, like thee, the single ruler over wealth My worshipper should be rich in kine.

2.3.s: yajña indramavardʰayadyadbʰūmiṃ vyavartayat cakrāṇa opaśaṃ divi
2.3.d: यज्ञ इन्द्रमवर्धयद्यद्भूमिं व्यवर्तयत् चक्राण ओपशं दिवि
2.3.e: Pressers, blend Soma juice for him, each draught most excellent, for him The brave, the hero, for his joy.

2.4.s: yadindrāhaṃ tatʰā tvamīśīya vasva eka it stotā me gosakʰā syāt
2.4.d: यदिन्द्राहं तथा त्वमीशीय वस्व एक इत् स्तोता मे गोसखा स्यात्
2.4.e: Here is the Soma juice expressed. O Vasu, drink till thou art full: Undaunted God, we give it thee

2.4.s: panyaṃpanyamitsotāra ā dʰāvata madyāya somaṃ vīrāya śūrāya
2.4.d: पन्यंपन्यमित्सोतार आ धावत मद्याय सोमं वीराय शूराय
2.4.e: Surya, thou mountest up to meet the hero famous for his wealth, Who hurls the bolt and works for man.

2.4.s: idaṃ vaso sutamandʰaḥ pibā supūrṇamudaram anābʰayinrarimā te
2.4.d: इदं वसो सुतमन्धः पिबा सुपूर्णमुदरम् अनाभयिन्ररिमा ते
2.4.e: Whatever, Vritra-slayer! thou, Surya hast risen upon to-day, That, Indra, all is in thy power.

2.4.s: uddʰedabʰi śrutāmagʰaṃ vr̥ṣabʰaṃ naryāpasam astārameṣi sūrya
2.4.d: उद्धेदभि श्रुतामघं वृषभं नर्यापसम् अस्तारमेषि सूर्य
2.4.e: That Indra is our youthful friend, who with his trusty guidanceled Turvasa, Yadu from afar.

2.4.s: yadadya kacca vr̥trahannudagā abʰi sūrya sarvaṃ tadindra te vaśe
2.4.d: यदद्य कच्च वृत्रहन्नुदगा अभि सूर्य सर्वं तदिन्द्र ते वशे
2.4.e: O Indra, let not ill designs surround us in the sunbeams' light This may we gain with thee for friend!

2.4.s: ya ānayatparāvataḥ sunītī turvaśaṃ yadum indraḥ sa no yuvā sakʰā
2.4.d: य आनयत्परावतः सुनीती तुर्वशं यदुम् इन्द्रः स नो युवा सखा
2.4.e: Indra, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor's ever-conquering wealth, Most excellent, to be our aid

2.4.s: mā na indrābʰyā ' '3 diśaḥ sūro aktuṣvā yamata tvā yujā vanema tat
2.4.d: मा न इन्द्राभ्या ऽ ऽ३ दिशः सूरो अक्तुष्वा यमत त्वा युजा वनेम तत्
2.4.e: In mighty battle we invoke Indra, Indra is lesser fight, The friend who bends his bolt at fiends.

2.4.s: endra sānasim̐ rayim̐ sajitvānam̐ sadāsaham varṣiṣṭʰamūtaye bʰara
2.4.d: एन्द्र सानसिꣳ रयिꣳ सजित्वानꣳ सदासहम् वर्षिष्ठमूतये भर
2.4.e: In battle of a thousand arms Indra drank Kadru's Soma juice There he displayed his manly might.

2.4.s: indraṃ vayaṃ mahādʰana indramarbʰe havāmahe yujaṃ vr̥treṣu vajriṇam
2.4.d: इन्द्रं वयं महाधन इन्द्रमर्भे हवामहे युजं वृत्रेषु वज्रिणम्
2.4.e: Faithful to thee, we sing aloud, heroic Indra, songs to thee Mark, O good Lord, this act of ours!
Hitherward! they who light the flame and straightway trim the sacred grass, Whose friend is Indra ever young.

2.5.s: vayamindra tvāyavo 'bʰi pra nonumo vr̥ṣan viddʰī tvā3sya no vaso
2.5.d: वयमिन्द्र त्वायवो ऽभि प्र नोनुमो वृषन् विद्धी त्वा३स्य नो वसो
2.5.e: Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around, And bring the wealth for which we long!

2.5.s: ā gʰā ye agnimindʰate str̥ṇanti barhirānuṣak yeṣāmindro yuvā sakʰā
2.5.d: आ घा ये अग्निमिन्धते स्तृणन्ति बर्हिरानुषक् येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा
2.5.e: I Hear, as though 'twere close at hand, the cracking of the whips they hold: They gather splendour on their way.

2.5.s: bʰindʰi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ pari bādʰo jahī mr̥dʰaḥ vasu spārhaṃ tadā bʰara
2.5.d: भिन्धि विश्वा अप द्विषः परि बाधो जही मृधः वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर
2.5.e: Indra, these friends of ours, supplied with Soma, wait and look to thee As men with fodder to the herd.

2.5.s: iheva śr̥ṇva eṣāṃ kaśā hasteṣu yadvadān ni yāmaṃ citramr̥ñjate
2.5.d: इहेव शृण्व एषां कशा हस्तेषु यद्वदान् नि यामं चित्रमृञ्जते
2.5.e: Before his hot displeasure all the peoples, all the men bow down, As rivers bow them to the sea.

2.5.s: ima u tvā vi cakṣate sakʰāya indra sominaḥ puṣṭāvanto yatʰā paśum
2.5.d: इम उ त्वा वि चक्षते सखाय इन्द्र सोमिनः पुष्टावन्तो यथा पशुम्
2.5.e: We choose unto ourselves that high protection of the mighty Gods, That it may help and succour us.

2.5.s: samasya manyave viśo viśvā namanta kr̥ṣṭayaḥ samudrāyeva sindʰavaḥ
2.5.d: समस्य मन्यवे विशो विश्वा नमन्त कृष्टयः समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः
2.5.e: O Brahmanaspati, make thou Kakshivan Ausija a loud Chanter of flowing Soma juice!
Much honoured with libations may the Vritra-slayer watch for us: May Sakra listen to our prayer

2.5.s: somānām̐ svaraṇaṃ kr̥ṇuhi brahmaṇaspate kakṣīvantaṃ ya auśijaḥ
2.5.d: सोमानाꣳ स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस्पते कक्षीवन्तं य औशिजः
2.5.e: Send us this day, God Savitar, prosperity with progeny Drive thou the evil dream away!

2.5.s: bodʰanmanā idastu no vr̥trahā bʰūryāsutiḥ śr̥ṇotu śakra āśiṣam
2.5.d: बोधन्मना इदस्तु नो वृत्रहा भूर्यासुतिः शृणोतु शक्र आशिषम्
2.5.e: Where is that ever-youthful Steer, strong-necked and never yet bent down? What Brahman ministers to him?

2.5.s: adya no deva savitaḥ prajāvatsāvīḥ saubʰagam parā duḥṣvapnyam̐ suva
2.5.d: अद्य नो देव सवितः प्रजावत्सावीः सौभगम् परा दुःष्वप्न्यꣳ सुव
2.5.e: There where the mountains downward slope, there at the meeting of the streams The Sage was manifest by song.

2.6.s: kvā3sya vr̥ṣabʰo yuvā tuvigrīvo anānataḥ brahmā kastam̐ saparyati
2.6.d: क्वा३स्य वृषभो युवा तुविग्रीवो अनानतः ब्रह्मा कस्तꣳ सपर्यति
2.6.e: Praise Indra whom our songs must laud, sole sovran of mankind, the chief Most liberal who controlleth men

2.6.s: upahvare girīṇām̐ saṅgame ca nadīnām dʰiyā vipro ajāyata
2.6.d: उपह्वरे गिरीणाꣳ सङ्गमे च नदीनाम् धिया विप्रो अजायत
2.6.e: Indra whose jaws are strong hath drunk of worshipping Sudaksha's draught, The Soma juice with barley brew.

2.6.s: pra samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnāmindram̐ stotā navyaṃ gīrbʰiḥ naraṃ nr̥ṣāhaṃ mam̐hiṣṭʰam
2.6.d: प्र सम्राजं चर्षणीनामिन्द्रꣳ स्तोता नव्यं गीर्भिः नरं नृषाहं मꣳहिष्ठम्
2.6.e: O Lord of ample wealth, these songs of praise have called aloud to thee, Like milch-kine lowing to their calves!

2.6.s: apādu śiprayandʰasaḥ sudakṣasya prahoṣiṇaḥ indrorindro yavāśiraḥ
2.6.d: अपादु शिप्रयन्धसः सुदक्षस्य प्रहोषिणः इन्द्रोरिन्द्रो यवाशिरः
2.6.e: Then straight they recognized the mystic name of the creative Steer, There in the mansion of the Moon.

2.6.s: imā u tvā puruvaso 'bʰi pra nonavurgiraḥ gāvo vatsaṃ na dʰenavaḥ
2.6.d: इमा उ त्वा पुरुवसो ऽभि प्र नोनवुर्गिरः गावो वत्सं न धेनवः
2.6.e: When Indra, strongest hero, brought the streams, the mighty waters down, Pushan was standing by his side.

2.6.s: atrāha goramanvata nāma tvaṣṭurapīcyam ittʰā candramaso gr̥he
2.6.d: अत्राह गोरमन्वत नाम त्वष्टुरपीच्यम् इत्था चन्द्रमसो गृहे
2.6.e: The Cow, the streaming mother of the liberal Maruts, pours her milk, Harnessed to draw their chariots on.

2.6.s: yadindro anayadrito mahīrapo vr̥ṣantamaḥ tatra pūṣābʰuvatsacā
2.6.d: यदिन्द्रो अनयद्रितो महीरपो वृषन्तमः तत्र पूषाभुवत्सचा
2.6.e: Come, Lord of rapturous joys, to our libation with thy bay steeds, come With bay steeds to the flowing juice

2.6.s: gaurdʰayati marutām̐ śravasyurmātā magʰonām yuktā vahnī ratʰānām
2.6.d: गौर्धयति मरुताꣳ श्रवस्युर्माता मघोनाम् युक्ता वह्नी रथानाम्
2.6.e: Presented strengthening gifts have sent Indra away at sacrifice, With night, unto the cleansing bath.

2.6.s: upa no haribʰiḥ sutaṃ yāhi madānāṃ pate upa no haribʰiḥ sutam
2.6.d: उप नो हरिभिः सुतं याहि मदानां पते उप नो हरिभिः सुतम्
2.6.e: I from my Father have received deep knowledge of eternal Law: I was born like unto the Sun.

2.6.s: iṣṭā hotrā asr̥kṣatendraṃ vr̥dʰanto adʰvare accʰāvabʰr̥tʰamojasā
2.6.d: इष्टा होत्रा असृक्षतेन्द्रं वृधन्तो अध्वरे अच्छावभृथमोजसा
2.6.e: With Indra splendid feasts be ours, rich in all strengthening things, wherewith, Wealthy in food, we may rejoice

2.7.s: ahamiddʰi pituṣpari medʰāmr̥tasya jagraha aham̐ sūrya ivājani
2.7.d: अहमिद्धि पितुष्परि मेधामृतस्य जग्रह अहꣳ सूर्य इवाजनि
2.7.e: Soma and Pushan, kind to him who travels to the Gods, provide Dwellings all happy and secure.

2.7.s: revatīrnaḥ sadʰamāda indre santu tuvivājāḥ kṣumanto yābʰirmadema
2.7.d: रेवतीर्नः सधमाद इन्द्रे सन्तु तुविवाजाः क्षुमन्तो याभिर्मदेम
2.7.e: Invite ye Indra with a song to drink your draught of Soma steeds, juice, All-conquering Satakratu, most munificent of all who live

2.7.s: somaḥ pūṣā ca cetaturviśvāsām̐ sukṣitīnām devatrā ratʰyorhitā
2.7.d: सोमः पूषा च चेततुर्विश्वासाꣳ सुक्षितीनाम् देवत्रा रथ्योर्हिता
2.7.e: Sing ye a song, to make him glad, to Indra, Lord of tawny The Soma-drinker, O my friends!

2.7.s: pāntamā vo andʰasa indramabʰi pra gāyata viśvāsāham̐ śatakratuṃ mam̐hiṣṭʰaṃ carṣaṇīnām
2.7.d: पान्तमा वो अन्धस इन्द्रमभि प्र गायत विश्वासाहꣳ शतक्रतुं मꣳहिष्ठं चर्षणीनाम्
2.7.e: This, even this, O Indra, we implore: as thy devoted friends The Kanvas praise thee with their hymns!

2.7.s: pra va indrāya mādanam̐ haryaśvāya gāyata sakʰāyaḥ somapāvne
2.7.d: प्र व इन्द्राय मादनꣳ हर्यश्वाय गायत सखायः सोमपाव्ने
2.7.e: For Indra, lover of carouse, loud be our songs about the juice Let poets sing the song of praise.

2.7.s: vayamu tvā tadidartʰā indra tvāyantaḥ sakʰāyaḥ kaṇvā uktʰebʰirjarante
2.7.d: वयमु त्वा तदिदर्था इन्द्र त्वायन्तः सखायः कण्वा उक्थेभिर्जरन्ते
2.7.e: Here, Indra, is thy Soma draught, made pure upon the sacred grass: Run hither, come and drink thereof

2.7.s: indrāya madvane sutaṃ pari ṣṭobʰantu no giraḥ arkamarcantu kāravaḥ
2.7.d: इन्द्राय मद्वने सुतं परि ष्टोभन्तु नो गिरः अर्कमर्चन्तु कारवः
2.7.e: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of good deeds To our assistance duy by day.

2.7.s: ayaṃ ta indra somo nipūto adʰi barhiṣi ehīmasya dravā piba
2.7.d: अयं त इन्द्र सोमो निपूतो अधि बर्हिषि एहीमस्य द्रवा पिब
2.7.e: Hero, the Soma being shed, I pour the juice for thee to drink Sate thee and finish thy carouse!
The Soma, Indra, which is shed in saucers and in cups for thee, Drink thou, for thou art lord thereof!

2.7.s: abʰi tvā vr̥ṣabʰā sute sutam̐ sr̥jāmi pītaye tr̥mpā vyaśnuhī madam
2.7.d: अभि त्वा वृषभा सुते सुतꣳ सृजामि पीतये तृम्पा व्यश्नुही मदम्
2.7.e: In every need, in every fray we call, as friends, to succour us, Indra, the mightiest of all.

2.8.s: ya indra camaseṣvā somaścamūṣu te sutaḥ pibedasya tvamīśiṣe
2.8.d: य इन्द्र चमसेष्वा सोमश्चमूषु ते सुतः पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे
2.8.e: O come ye hither, sit ye down: to Indra sing ye forth your song, Companions, bringing hymns of praise

2.8.s: yogeyoge tavastaraṃ vājevāje havāmahe sakʰāya indramūtaye
2.8.d: योगेयोगे तवस्तरं वाजेवाजे हवामहे सखाय इन्द्रमूतये
2.8.e: So, Lord of affluent gifts, this juice hath been expressed for thee with strength: Drink of it, thou who lovest song!

2.8.s: ā tvetā ni ṣīdatendramabʰi pra gāyata sakʰāyaḥ stomavāhasaḥ
2.8.d: आ त्वेता नि षीदतेन्द्रमभि प्र गायत सखायः स्तोमवाहसः
2.8.e: Great is our Indra from of old; greatness be his, the Thunderer Wide as the heaven extends his might.

2.8.s: idam̐ hyanvojasā sutam̐ rādʰānāṃ pate pibā tvā3sya girvaṇaḥ
2.8.d: इदꣳ ह्यन्वोजसा सुतꣳ राधानां पते पिबा त्वा३स्य गिर्वणः
2.8.e: Indra, as one with mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand Manifold and nutritious spoil!

2.8.s: mahām̐ indraḥ puraśca no mahitvamastu vajriṇe dyaurna pratʰinā śavaḥ
2.8.d: महाꣳ इन्द्रः पुरश्च नो महित्वमस्तु वज्रिणे द्यौर्न प्रथिना शवः
2.8.e: Praise, even as he is known, with song Indra the guardian of the kine, The Son of Truth, Lord of the brave.

2.8.s: ā tū na indra kṣumantaṃ citraṃ grābʰam̐ saṃ gr̥bʰāya mahāhastī dakṣiṇena
2.8.d: आ तू न इन्द्र क्षुमन्तं चित्रं ग्राभꣳ सं गृभाय महाहस्ती दक्षिणेन
2.8.e: With what help will he come to us, wonderful, ever-waxing friend? With what most mighty company?

2.8.s: abʰi pra gopatiṃ girendramarca yatʰā vide sūnum̐ satyasya satpatim
2.8.d: अभि प्र गोपतिं गिरेन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे सूनुꣳ सत्यस्य सत्पतिम्
2.8.e: Thou speedest down to succour us this ever-conquering God of yours Him who is drawn to all our songs.

2.8.s: kayā naścitra ā bʰuvadūtī sadāvr̥dʰaḥ sakʰā kayā śaciṣṭʰayā vr̥tā
2.8.d: कया नश्चित्र आ भुवदूती सदावृधः सखा कया शचिष्ठया वृता
2.8.e: To the assembly's wondrous Lord, the lovely friend of Indra, I Had prayed for wisdom and successs.

2.8.s: tyamu vaḥ satrāsāhaṃ viśvāsu gīrṣvāyatam ā cyāvayasyūtaye
2.8.d: त्यमु वः सत्रासाहं विश्वासु गीर्ष्वायतम् आ च्यावयस्यूतये
2.8.e: May all thy paths beneath the sky whereby thou speddest Vyasva on, Yea, let all spaces hear our voice
Bring to us all things excellent, O Satakratu, food and strength, For, Indra, thou art kind to us!

2.9.s: ye te pantʰā adʰo divo yebʰirvyaśvamairayaḥ uta śroṣantu no bʰuvaḥ
2.9.d: ये ते पन्था अधो दिवो येभिर्व्यश्वमैरयः उत श्रोषन्तु नो भुवः
2.9.e: Here is the Soma ready pressed: of this the Maruts, yea, of this, Self-luminous the Asvins drink.

2.9.s: bʰadraṃbʰadraṃ na ā bʰareṣamūrjam̐ śatakrato yadindra mr̥ḍayāsi naḥ
2.9.d: भद्रंभद्रं न आ भरेषमूर्जꣳ शतक्रतो यदिन्द्र मृडयासि नः
2.9.e: Tossing about, the active ones came nigh to Indra at his birth, Winning themselves heroic might.

2.9.s: asti somo ayam̐ sutaḥ pibantyasya marutaḥ uta svarājo aśvinā
2.9.d: अस्ति सोमो अयꣳ सुतः पिबन्त्यस्य मरुतः उत स्वराजो अश्विना
2.9.e: Never, O Gods, do we offend, nor are we ever obstinate We walk as holy texts command.
Evening is come: sing loudly thou Atharvan's nobly singing son: Give praise to Savitar the God!

2.9.s: na ki devā inīmasi na kyā yopayāmasi mantraśrutyaṃ carāmasi
2.9.d: न कि देवा इनीमसि न क्या योपयामसि मन्त्रश्रुत्यं चरामसि
2.9.e: Now Morning with her earliest light shines forth, dear daughter of the Sky: High, Asvins, I extol your praise.

2.9.s: doṣo āgādbr̥hadgāya dyumadgāmannātʰarvaṇa stuhi devam̐ savitāram
2.9.d: दोषो आगाद्बृहद्गाय द्युमद्गामन्नाथर्वण स्तुहि देवꣳ सवितारम्
2.9.e: Armed with the bones of dead Dadhyach, Indra, with unresisted might The nine-and-ninety Vritras slew.

2.9.s: eṣo uṣā apūrvyā vyuccʰati priyā divaḥ stuṣe vāmaśvinā br̥hat
2.9.d: एषो उषा अपूर्व्या व्युच्छति प्रिया दिवः स्तुषे वामश्विना बृहत्
2.9.e: Come, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all our Soma feasts, Protector, mighty in thy strength
O thou who slayest Vritras, come, O Indra, hither to our side, Mighty one, with thy mighty aids!

2.9.s: indrehi matsyandʰaso viśvebʰiḥ somaparvabʰiḥ mahām̐ abʰiṣṭirojasā
2.9.d: इन्द्रेहि मत्स्यन्धसो विश्वेभिः सोमपर्वभिः महाꣳ अभिष्टिरोजसा
2.9.e: That might of his shone brightly forth when Indra brought together, like A skin, the worlds of heaven and earth,

2.9.s: ā tū na indra vr̥trahannasmākamardʰamā gahi mahānmahībʰirūtibʰiḥ
2.9.d: आ तू न इन्द्र वृत्रहन्नस्माकमर्धमा गहि महान्महीभिरूतिभिः
2.9.e: This is thine own Thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate: Thou carest, too, for this our prayer.

2.10.s: ojastadasya titviṣa ubʰe yatsamavartayat indraścarmeva rodasī
2.10.d: ओजस्तदस्य तित्विष उभे यत्समवर्तयत् इन्द्रश्चर्मेव रोदसी
2.10.e: May Vata breathe his balm on us, healthful, delightful to our heart: May he prolong our days of life

2.10.s: ayamu te samatasi kapota iva garbʰadʰim vacastaccinna ohase
2.10.d: अयमु ते समतसि कपोत इव गर्भधिम् वचस्तच्चिन्न ओहसे
2.10.e: Ne'er is he injured whom the Gods Varuna, Mitra, Aryam. The excellently wise, protect.

2.10.s: vāta ā vātu beṣajam̐ śambʰu mayobʰu no hr̥de pra na ayūm̐ṣi tāriṣat
2.10.d: वात आ वातु बेषजꣳ शम्भु मयोभु नो हृदे प्र न अयूꣳषि तारिषत्
2.10.e: According to our wish for kine, for steeds and chariots, as of old, Be gracious to our wealthy chiefs

2.10.s: yam̐ rakṣanti pracetaso varuṇo mitro aryamā na kiḥ sa dabʰyate janaḥ
2.10.d: यꣳ रक्षन्ति प्रचेतसो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा न किः स दभ्यते जनः
2.10.e: Indra, these spotted cows yield thee their butter and the milky draught, Aiders, thereby, of sacrifice.

2.10.s: gavyo ṣu ṇo yatʰā purāśvayota ratʰayā varivasyā mahonām
2.10.d: गव्यो षु णो यथा पुराश्वयोत रथया वरिवस्या महोनाम्
2.10.e: That thou much-lauded! many-named! mayst, with this thought, that longs for milk, Come to each Soma sacrifice.

2.10.s: imāsta indra pr̥śnayo gʰr̥taṃ duhata āśiram enāmr̥tasya pipyuṣīḥ
2.10.d: इमास्त इन्द्र पृश्नयो घृतं दुहत आशिरम् एनामृतस्य पिप्युषीः
2.10.e: May bright Sarasvati, endowed with plenteous wealth and spoil, enriched With prayer, desire the sacrifice.

2.10.s: ayā dʰiyā ca gavyayā puruṇāmanpuruṣṭuta yatsomesoma ābʰuvaḥ
2.10.d: अया धिया च गव्यया पुरुणामन्पुरुष्टुत यत्सोमेसोम आभुवः
2.10.e: Why 'mid the Nahusha tribes shall sate this Indra with his Soma juice? He shall bring precious things to us.

2.10.s: pāvakā naḥ sarasvatī vājebʰirvājinīvatī yajñaṃ vaṣṭu dʰiyāvasuḥ
2.10.d: पावका नः सरस्वती वाजेभिर्वाजिनीवती यज्ञं वष्टु धियावसुः
2.10.e: Come, we have pressed the juice for thee; O Indra, drink this Soma here: Sit thou on this my sacred grass

2.10.s: ka imaṃ nāhuṣīṣvā indram̐ somasya tarpayāt sa no vasūnyā bʰarāt
2.10.d: क इमं नाहुषीष्वा इन्द्रꣳ सोमस्य तर्पयात् स नो वसून्या भरात्
2.10.e: Great, unassailable must be the heavenly favour of the Three, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.

3.1.s: ā yāhi suṣumā hi ta indra somaṃ pibā imam edaṃ barhiḥ sado mama
3.1.d: आ याहि सुषुमा हि त इन्द्र सोमं पिबा इमम् एदं बर्हिः सदो मम
3.1.e: We, Indra, Lord of ample wealth, our guide, depend on one like thee, Thou driver of the tawny steeds!

3.1.s: mahi trīṇāmavarastu dyukṣaṃ mitrasyāryamṇaḥ durādʰarṣaṃ varuṇasya
3.1.d: महि त्रीणामवरस्तु द्युक्षं मित्रस्यार्यम्णः दुराधर्षं वरुणस्य
3.1.e: Let Soma juices make thee glad! Display thy bounty, Thunderer: Drive off the enemies of prayer!

3.1.s: tvāvataḥ purūvaso vayamindra praṇetaḥ smasi stʰātarharīṇām
3.1.d: त्वावतः पुरूवसो वयमिन्द्र प्रणेतः स्मसि स्थातर्हरीणाम्
3.1.e: Drink our libation, Lord of hymns! with streams of meath thou art bedewed: Yea, Indra, glory is thy gift.

3.1.s: uttvā mandantu somāḥ kr̥ṇuṣva rādʰo adrivaḥ ava brahmadviṣo jahi
3.1.d: उत्त्वा मन्दन्तु सोमाः कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः अव ब्रह्मद्विषो जहि
3.1.e: Indra hath ever thought of you and tended you with care. The God, Heroic Indra, is not checked.

3.1.s: girvaṇaḥ pāhi naḥ sutaṃ madʰordʰārābʰirajyase indra tvādātamidyaśaḥ
3.1.d: गिर्वणः पाहि नः सुतं मधोर्धाराभिरज्यसे इन्द्र त्वादातमिद्यशः
3.1.e: Let the drops pass within thee as the rivers flow into the sea O Indra, naught excelleth thee!

3.1.s: sadā va indraścarkr̥ṣadā upo nu sa saparyan na devo vr̥taḥ śūra indraḥ
3.1.d: सदा व इन्द्रश्चर्कृषदा उपो नु स सपर्यन् न देवो वृतः शूर इन्द्रः
3.1.e: Indra, the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.

3.1.s: ā tvā viśantvindavaḥ samudramiva sindʰavaḥ na tvāmindrāti ricyate
3.1.d: आ त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते
3.1.e: May Indra give, to aid us wealth handy that rules the skilful ones! Yea, may the Strong give potent wealth
Verily Indra, conquering all, drives even mighty fear away, For firm is he and swift to act.

3.1.s: indra iṣe dadātu na r̥bʰukṣaṇamr̥bʰum̐ rayim vājī dadātu vājinam
3.1.d: इन्द्र इषे ददातु न ऋभुक्षणमृभुꣳ रयिम् वाजी ददातु वाजिनम्
3.1.e: These songs with every draught we pour come, lover of the song, to thee As milch-kine hasten to their calves.

3.1.s: indro aṅga mahadbʰayamabʰī ṣadapa cucyavat sa hi stʰiro vicarṣaṇiḥ
3.1.d: इन्द्रो अङ्ग महद्भयमभी षदप चुच्यवत् स हि स्थिरो विचर्षणिः
3.1.e: Indra and Wishan will we call for friendship and prosperity, And for the winning of the spoil.

3.2.s: imā u tvā sutesute nakṣante girvaṇo giraḥ gāvo vatsaṃ na dʰenavaḥ
3.2.d: इमा उ त्वा सुतेसुते नक्षन्ते गिर्वणो गिरः गावो वत्सं न धेनवः
3.2.e: O Indra, Vritra-slayer, naught is better, mightier than thou Verily there is none like thee!

3.2.s: indrā nu pūṣaṇā vayam̐ sakʰyāya svastaye huvema vājasātaye
3.2.d: इन्द्रा नु पूषणा वयꣳ सख्याय स्वस्तये हुवेम वाजसातये
3.2.e: Him have I magnified, our Lord in common, guardian of your folk, Discloser of great wealth in kine.

3.2.s: na ki indra tvaduttaraṃ na jyāyo asti vr̥trahan na kyevaṃ yatʰā tvam
3.2.d: न कि इन्द्र त्वदुत्तरं न ज्यायो अस्ति वृत्रहन् न क्येवं यथा त्वम्
3.2.e: Songs have outpoured themselves to thee, Indra, the strong, the guardian Lord, And with one will have risen to thee!

3.2.s: taraṇiṃ vo janānāṃ tradaṃ vājasya gomataḥ samānamu pra śam̐siṣam
3.2.d: तरणिं वो जनानां त्रदं वाजस्य गोमतः समानमु प्र शꣳसिषम्
3.2.e: Good guidance hath the mortal man whom Arya-man, the Marut host, And Mitras, void of guile, protect.

3.2.s: asr̥gramindra te giraḥ prati tvāmudahāsata sajoṣā vr̥ṣabʰaṃ patim
3.2.d: असृग्रमिन्द्र ते गिरः प्रति त्वामुदहासत सजोषा वृषभं पतिम्
3.2.e: Bring us the wealth for which we long, O Indra, that which is concealed In strong firm place precipitous.

3.2.s: sunītʰo gʰā sa martyo yaṃ maruto yamaryamā mitrāspāntyadruhaḥ
3.2.d: सुनीथो घा स मर्त्यो यं मरुतो यमर्यमा मित्रास्पान्त्यद्रुहः
3.2.e: Him your best Vritra-slayer, him the famous champion of mankind I urge to great munificence.

3.2.s: yadvīḍāvindra yatstʰire yatparśāne parābʰr̥tam vasu spārhaṃ tadā bʰara
3.2.d: यद्वीडाविन्द्र यत्स्थिरे यत्पर्शाने पराभृतम् वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर
3.2.e: Indra, may we adorn thy fame, fame of one like thee, hero! deck, Sakra! thy fame at highest feast!

3.2.s: śrutaṃ vo vr̥trahantamaṃ pra śardʰaṃ carṣaṇīnām āśiṣe rādʰase mahe
3.2.d: श्रुतं वो वृत्रहन्तमं प्र शर्धं चर्षणीनाम् आशिषे राधसे महे
3.2.e: Indra, accept at break of day our Soma mixt with roasted corn, With groats, with cake, with eulogies!

3.2.s: araṃ ta indra śravase gamema śūra tvāvataḥ aram̐ śakra paremaṇi
3.2.d: अरं त इन्द्र श्रवसे गमेम शूर त्वावतः अरꣳ शक्र परेमणि
3.2.e: With waters' foam thou torest off, Indra, the head of Namuchi, When thou o'ercamest all the foes.
Thine are these Soma juices, thine, Indra, those still to be expressed: Enjoy them, Lord of princely wealth!

3.2.s: apāṃ pʰenena namuceḥ śira indrodavartayaḥ viśvā yadajaya spr̥dʰaḥ
3.2.d: अपां फेनेन नमुचेः शिर इन्द्रोदवर्तयः विश्वा यदजय स्पृधः
3.2.e: For thee, O Indra, Lord of light, Somas are pressed and grass is strewn: Be gracious to thy worshippers!

3.2.s: ime ta indra somāḥ sutāso ye ca sotvāḥ teṣāṃ matsva prabʰūvaso
3.2.d: इमे त इन्द्र सोमाः सुतासो ये च सोत्वाः तेषां मत्स्व प्रभूवसो
3.2.e: We seeking strength, with Soma drops fill full your Indra like a well, Most liberal, Lord of boundless might.

3.2.s: tubʰyam̐ sutāsaḥ somāḥ stīrṇaṃ barhirvibʰāvaso stotr̥bʰya indra mr̥ḍaya
3.2.d: तुभ्यꣳ सुतासः सोमाः स्तीर्णं बर्हिर्विभावसो स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्र मृडय
3.2.e: O Indra, even from that place come unto us with food that gives A hundred, yea, a thousand powers!

3.2.s: ā va indra kr̥viṃ yatʰā vājayantaḥ śatakratum mam̐hiṣṭʰam̐ siñca indubʰiḥ
3.2.d: आ व इन्द्र कृविं यथा वाजयन्तः शतक्रतुम् मꣳहिष्ठꣳ सिञ्च इन्दुभिः
3.2.e: The new-born Vritra-slayer asked his mother, as he seized his shaft, Who are the, fierce and famous ones?

3.2.s: ataścidindra na upā yāhi śatavājayā iṣā sahasravājayā
3.2.d: अतश्चिदिन्द्र न उपा याहि शतवाजया इषा सहस्रवाजया
3.2.e: Let us call him to aid whose hands stretch far, the highly-lauded, who Fulfils the work to favour us

3.2.s: ā bundaṃ vr̥trahā dade jātaḥ pr̥ccʰadvi mātaram ka ugrāḥ ke ha śr̥ṇvire
3.2.d: आ बुन्दं वृत्रहा ददे जातः पृच्छद्वि मातरम् क उग्राः के ह शृण्विरे
3.2.e: Mitra who knoweth leadeth us, and Varuna who guideth straight, And Aryaman in accord with Gods.
When, even as she were present here, red Dawn hath shone from far away, She spreadeth light on every side.

3.2.s: r̥junītī no varuṇo mitro nayati vidvān aryamā devaiḥ sajoṣāḥ
3.2.d: ऋजुनीती नो वरुणो मित्रो नयति विद्वान् अर्यमा देवैः सजोषाः
3.2.e: Varuna, Mitra, sapient pair, pour fatness on our pastures, pour Meath on the regions of the air!

3.2.d: दूरादिहेव यत्सतो ऽरुणप्सुरशिश्वितत् वि भानुं विश्वथातनत्
3.2.e: And, at our sacrifices, these, sons, singers, have enlarged their bounds, So that the cows must walk knee-deep.

3.4.s: ā no mitrāvaruṇā gʰr̥tairgavyūtimukṣatam madʰvā rajām̐si sukratū
3.4.d: आ नो मित्रावरुणा घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतम् मध्वा रजाꣳसि सुक्रतू
3.4.e: Through all this world strode Vishnu: thrice his foot he planted, and the whole Was gathered in his footstep's dust.

3.4.s: udu tye sūnavo giraḥ kāṣṭʰā yajñeṣvatnata vāśrā abʰijñu yātave
3.4.d: उदु त्ये सूनवो गिरः काष्ठा यज्ञेष्वत्नत वाश्रा अभिज्ञु यातवे
3.4.e: Pass by the wrathful offerer; speed the man who pours libation, drink The juice which he presents to thee!

3.4.s: idaṃ viṣṇurvi cakrame tredʰā ni dadʰe padam samūḍʰamasya pām̐sule
3.4.d: इदं विष्णुर्वि चक्रमे त्रेधा नि दधे पदम् समूढमस्य पाꣳसुले
3.4.e: What is the word addressed to him, God great and excellently wise? For this is what exalteth him. 3, His wealth who hath no store of kine hath ne'er found out recited laud, Nor song of praises that is sung.

3.4.s: atīhi manyuṣāviṇam̐ suṣuvām̐samuperaya asya rātau sutaṃ piba
3.4.d: अतीहि मन्युषाविणꣳ सुषुवाꣳसमुपेरय अस्य रातौ सुतं पिब
3.4.e: Lord of each thing that giveth strength, Indra delighteth most in lauds, Borne by bay steeds, libations' friend.

3.4.s: kadu pracetase mahe vaco devāya śasyate tadidʰyasya vardʰanam
3.4.d: कदु प्रचेतसे महे वचो देवाय शस्यते तदिध्यस्य वर्धनम्
3.4.e: With wealth to our libation come, be not thou angry with us, like A great man with a youthful bride.

3.4.s: uktʰaṃ ca na śasyamānaṃ nāgo rayirā ciketa na gāyatraṃ gīyamānam
3.4.d: उक्थं च न शस्यमानं नागो रयिरा चिकेत न गायत्रं गीयमानम्
3.4.e: When, Vasu, wilt thou love the laud? Now let the Channel bring the stream. The juice is ready to ferment.

3.4.s: indra uktʰebʰirmandiṣṭʰo vājānāṃ ca vājapatiḥ harivāntsutānām̐ sakʰā
3.4.d: इन्द्र उक्थेभिर्मन्दिष्ठो वाजानां च वाजपतिः हरिवान्त्सुतानाꣳ सखा
3.4.e: After the Seasons. Indra, drink the Soma from the Brahman's gift: Thy friendship is invincible! S. O Indra, lover of the song, we are the singers of thy praise O Soma-drinker, quicken us!

3.4.s: ā yāhyupa naḥ sutaṃ vājebʰirmā hr̥ṇīyatʰāḥ mahām̐ iva yuvajāniḥ
3.4.d: आ याह्युप नः सुतं वाजेभिर्मा हृणीयथाः महाꣳ इव युवजानिः
3.4.e: O Indra, in each fight and fray give to our bodies manly strength: Strong Lord, grant ever-conquering might!

3.5.s: kadā vaso stotram̐ haryata ā ava śmaśā rudʰadvāḥ dīrgʰam̐ sutam vātāpyāya
3.5.d: कदा वसो स्तोत्रꣳ हर्यत आ अव श्मशा रुधद्वाः दीर्घꣳ सुतम् वाताप्याय
3.5.e: For so thou art the brave man's friend; a hero, too, art thou, and strong: So may thine heart be won to us!

3.5.s: brāhmaṇādindra rādʰasaḥ pibā somamr̥tūm̐ ranu tavedam̐ sakʰyamastr̥tam
3.5.d: ब्राह्मणादिन्द्र राधसः पिबा सोममृतूꣳ रनु तवेदꣳ सख्यमस्तृतम्
3.5.e: Like kine unmilked we call aloud, hero, to thee, and sing thy praise, Looker on heavenly light, Lord of this moving world, Lord, Indra, of what moveth not!

3.5.s: vayaṃ gʰā te api smasi stotāra indra girvaṇaḥ tvaṃ no jinva somapāḥ
3.5.d: वयं घा ते अपि स्मसि स्तोतार इन्द्र गिर्वणः त्वं नो जिन्व सोमपाः
3.5.e: That we may win us wealth and power we poets, verily, call on thee: In war men call on thee, Indra, the hero's Lord, in the steed's race-course call on thee:

3.5.s: endra pr̥kṣu kāsu cinnr̥mṇaṃ tanūṣu dʰehi naḥ satrājidugra paum̐syam
3.5.d: एन्द्र पृक्षु कासु चिन्नृम्णं तनूषु धेहि नः सत्राजिदुग्र पौꣳस्यम्
3.5.e: To you will I sing Indra's praise who gives good gifts as well we know; The praise of Maghavan who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousandfold.

3.5.s: evā hyasi vīrayurevā śūra uta stʰiraḥ evā te rādʰyaṃ manaḥ
3.5.d: एवा ह्यसि वीरयुरेवा शूर उत स्थिरः एवा ते राध्यं मनः
3.5.e: As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your wondrous God who checks attack, who takes delight in precious juice.

3.5.s: abʰi tvā śūra nonumo 'dugdʰā iva dʰenavaḥ īśānamasya jagataḥ svardr̥śamīśānamindra tastʰuṣaḥ
3.5.d: अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमो ऽदुग्धा इव धेनवः ईशानमस्य जगतः स्वर्दृशमीशानमिन्द्र तस्थुषः
3.5.e: Loud singing at the sacred rite where Soma flows we priests invoke With haste, that he may help, as the bard's cherisher, Indra who findeth wealth for you

3.5.s: tvāmiddʰi havāmahe sātau vājasya kārvaḥ tvāṃ vr̥treṣvindra satpatiṃ narastvāṃ kāṣṭʰāsvarvataḥ
3.5.d: त्वामिद्धि हवामहे सातौ वाजस्य कार्वः त्वां वृत्रेष्विन्द्र सत्पतिं नरस्त्वां काष्ठास्वर्वतः
3.5.e: With Plenty for his true ally the active man will gain the spoil. Your Indra, much-invoked, I bend with song, as bends a wright his wheel of solid wood.

3.5.s: abʰi pra vaḥ surādʰasamindramarca yatʰā vide yo jaritr̥bʰyo magʰavā purūvasuḥ sahasreṇeva śikṣati
3.5.d: अभि प्र वः सुराधसमिन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे यो जरितृभ्यो मघवा पुरूवसुः सहस्रेणेव शिक्षति
3.5.e: Drink, Indra, of the savoury juice, and cheer thee with our milky draught! Be, for our weal, our friend and sharer of the feast, and let thy wisdom guard us well!

3.5.s: taṃ vo dasmamr̥tīṣahaṃ vasormandānamandʰasaḥ abʰi vatsaṃ na svasareṣu dʰenava indraṃ gīrbʰirnavāmahe
3.5.d: तं वो दस्ममृतीषहं वसोर्मन्दानमन्धसः अभि वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे
3.5.e: For thou--come to the worshipper!--wilt find great wealth to make us rich. Fill thyself full, O Maghavan, for gain of kine, full, Indra, for the gain of steeds!

3.5.s: tarobʰirvo vidadvasumindram̐ sabādʰa ūtaye br̥hadgāyantaḥ sutasome adʰvare huve bʰaraṃ na kāriṇam
3.5.d: तरोभिर्वो विदद्वसुमिन्द्रꣳ सबाध ऊतये बृहद्गायन्तः सुतसोमे अध्वरे हुवे भरं न कारिणम्
3.5.e: Vasishtha will not overlook the lowliest one among you all Beside our Soma juice effused to-day let all the Maruts drink with eager haste!

3.6.s: taraṇiritsiṣāsati vājaṃ purandʰyā yujā ā va indraṃ puruhūtaṃ name girā nemiṃ taṣṭeva sudruvam
3.6.d: तरणिरित्सिषासति वाजं पुरन्ध्या युजा आ व इन्द्रं पुरुहूतं नमे गिरा नेमिं तष्टेव सुद्रुवम्
3.6.e: Glorify naught besides, O friends; so shall no sorrow trouble you! Praise only mighty Indra when the juice is shed, and say your lauds repeatedly!

3.6.s: pibā sutasya rasino matsvā na indra gomataḥ āpirno bodʰi sadʰamādye vr̥dʰe3 'smām̐ avantu te dʰiyaḥ
3.6.d: पिबा सुतस्य रसिनो मत्स्वा न इन्द्र गोमतः आपिर्नो बोधि सधमाद्ये वृधे३ ऽस्माꣳ अवन्तु ते धियः
3.6.e: No one by deed attains to him who works and strengthens evermore: No, not by sacrifice, to Indra. praised of all, resistless, daring, bold in might. 2 He without ligature, before making incision in the neck, Closed up the wound again, most wealthy Maghavan, who healeth the dissevered parts.

3.6.s: tvam̐ hyehi cerave vidā bʰagaṃ vasuttaye udvāvr̥ṣasva magʰavangaviṣṭaya udindrāśvamiṣṭaye
3.6.d: त्वꣳ ह्येहि चेरवे विदा भगं वसुत्तये उद्वावृषस्व मघवन्गविष्टय उदिन्द्राश्वमिष्टये
3.6.e: A thousand and a hundred steeds are harnessed to thy golden car: Yoked by devotion, Indra, let the long-maned bays bring thee to drink the Soma juice!

3.6.s: na hi vaścaramaṃ ca na vasiṣṭʰaḥ parimam̐ste asmākamadya marutaḥ sute sacā viśve pibantu kāminaḥ
3.6.d: न हि वश्चरमं च न वसिष्ठः परिमꣳस्ते अस्माकमद्य मरुतः सुते सचा विश्वे पिबन्तु कामिनः
3.6.e: Come hither, Indra, with bay steeds, joyous, with tails like peacock's plumes! Let no men check thy course as fowlers stay the bird: pass o'er them as o'er desert lands!

3.6.s: mā cidanyadvi śam̐sata sakʰāyo mā riṣaṇyata indramitstotā vr̥ṣaṇam̐ sacā sute muhuruktʰā ca śam̐sata
3.6.d: मा चिदन्यद्वि शꣳसत सखायो मा रिषण्यत इन्द्रमित्स्तोता वृषणꣳ सचा सुते मुहुरुक्था च शꣳसत
3.6.e: Thou as a God, O mightiest, verily blessest mortal man. O Maghavan, there is no comforter but thou: Indra, I speak my words to thee.

3.6.s: na kiṣṭaṃ karmaṇā naśadyaścakāra sadāvr̥dʰam indraṃ na yajñairviśvagūrtamr̥bʰvasamadʰr̥ṣṭaṃ dʰr̥ṣṇumojasā
3.6.d: न किष्टं कर्मणा नशद्यश्चकार सदावृधम् इन्द्रं न यज्ञैर्विश्वगूर्तमृभ्वसमधृष्टं धृष्णुमोजसा
3.6.e: O Indra, thou art far-renowned, impetuous Lord of power and might. Alone, the never-conquered guardian of mankind, thou smitest down resistless foes.

3.6.s: ya r̥te cidabʰiśriṣaḥ purā jatrubʰya ātr̥daḥ sandʰātā sandʰiṃ magʰavā purūvasurniṣkartā vihrutaṃ punaḥ
3.6.d: य ऋते चिदभिश्रिषः पुरा जत्रुभ्य आतृदः सन्धाता सन्धिं मघवा पुरूवसुर्निष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः
3.6.e: Indra for worship of the Gods, Indra while sacrifice proceeds, Indra, as warriors in the battle-shock, we call, Indra that we may win the spoil.

3.6.s: ā tvā sahasramā śataṃ yuktā ratʰe hiraṇyaye brahmayujo haraya indra keśino vahantu somapītaye
3.6.d: आ त्वा सहस्रमा शतं युक्ता रथे हिरण्यये ब्रह्मयुजो हरय इन्द्र केशिनो वहन्तु सोमपीतये
3.6.e: May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth! Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.

3.6.s: ā mandrairindra haribʰiryāhi mayūraromabʰiḥ mā tvā ke cinni yemurinna pāśino 'ti dʰanveva tām̐ ihi
3.6.d: आ मन्द्रैरिन्द्र हरिभिर्याहि मयूररोमभिः मा त्वा के चिन्नि येमुरिन्न पाशिनो ऽति धन्वेव ताꣳ इहि
3.6.e: These songs of ours exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise ascend to thee, Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength gain wealth and give unfailing help.

3.7.s: tvamaṅga pra śam̐siṣo devaḥ śaviṣṭʰa martyam na tvadanyo magʰavannasti marḍitendra bravīmi te vacaḥ
3.7.d: त्वमङ्ग प्र शꣳसिषो देवः शविष्ठ मर्त्यम् न त्वदन्यो मघवन्नस्ति मर्डितेन्द्र ब्रवीमि ते वचः
3.7.e: Even as the wild-bull, when he thirsts, goes to the desert's watery pool, Come to us quickly both at morning and at eve, and with the Kanvas drink thy fill!

3.7.s: tvamindra yaśā asyr̥jīṣī śavasaspatiḥ tvaṃ vr̥trāṇi ham̐syapratīnyeka itpurvanuttaścarṣaṇīdʰr̥tiḥ
3.7.d: त्वमिन्द्र यशा अस्यृजीषी शवसस्पतिः त्वं वृत्राणि हꣳस्यप्रतीन्येक इत्पुर्वनुत्तश्चर्षणीधृतिः
3.7.e: Indra, with all thy saving helps assist us, Lord of power and might! For after thee we follow even as glorious bliss, thee, hero, finderout of wealth.

3.7.s: indramiddevatātaya indraṃ prayatyadʰvare indram̐ samīke vanino havāmaha indraṃ dʰanasya sātaye
3.7.d: इन्द्रमिद्देवतातय इन्द्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे इन्द्रꣳ समीके वनिनो हवामह इन्द्रं धनस्य सातये
3.7.e: O Indra, Lord of light, what joys thou broughtest from the Asuras, Prosper therewith, O Maghavan, him who lauds that deed, and those whose grass is trimmed for thee!

3.7.s: imā u tvā purūvaso giro vardʰantu yā mama pāvakavarṇāḥ śucayo vipaścito 'bʰi stomairanūṣata
3.7.d: इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्धन्तु या मम पावकवर्णाः शुचयो विपश्चितो ऽभि स्तोमैरनूषत
3.7.e: To Aryaman and Mitra sing a reverent song, O pious one, A pleasant hymn to Varuna who shelters us: sing ye a laud unto the Kings!

3.7.s: udu tye madʰumattamā gira stomāsa īrate satrājito dʰanasā akṣitotayo vājayanto ratʰā iva
3.7.d: उदु त्ये मधुमत्तमा गिर स्तोमास ईरते सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयो वाजयन्तो रथा इव
3.7.e: Men with their lauds are urging thee, Indra, to drink the Soma first. The Ribhus in accord have lifted up their voice, and Rudras sung thee as the first.

3.7.s: yatʰā gauro apā kr̥taṃ tr̥ṣyannetyaveriṇam āpitve naḥ prapitve tūyamā gahi kaṇveṣu su sacā piba
3.7.d: यथा गौरो अपा कृतं तृष्यन्नेत्यवेरिणम् आपित्वे नः प्रपित्वे तूयमा गहि कण्वेषु सु सचा पिब
3.7.e: Sing to your lofty Indra, sing, Maruts, a holy hymn of praise Let Satakratu, Vritra-slayer, slay the foe with hundred-knotted thunderbolt!

3.7.s: śagdʰyū3ṣu śacīpata indra viśvābʰirūtibʰiḥ bʰagaṃ na hi tvā yaśasaṃ vasuvidamanu śūra carāmasi
3.7.d: शग्ध्यू३षु शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः भगं न हि त्वा यशसं वसुविदमनु शूर चरामसि
3.7.e: To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts! that slays the Vritras best, Whereby the holy ones created for the God the light divine that ever wakes.

3.7.s: yā indra bʰuja ābʰaraḥ svarvām̐ asurebʰyaḥ stotāraminmagʰavannasya vardʰaya ye ca tve vr̥ktabarhiṣaḥ
3.7.d: या इन्द्र भुज आभरः स्वर्वाꣳ असुरेभ्यः स्तोतारमिन्मघवन्नस्य वर्धय ये च त्वे वृक्तबर्हिषः
3.7.e: O Indra, give us wisdom as a sire gives wisdom to his sons Guide us, O much-invoked, in this our way: may we still live and look upon the light!

3.7.s: pra mitrāya prāryamṇe sacatʰyamr̥tāvaso varūtʰye3 varuṇe cʰandyaṃ vacaḥ stotram̐ rājasu gāyata
3.7.d: प्र मित्राय प्रार्यम्णे सचथ्यमृतावसो वरूथ्ये३ वरुणे छन्द्यं वचः स्तोत्रꣳ राजसु गायत
3.7.e: O Indra, turn us not away: be present with us at our feast For thou art our protection, yea, thou art our kin: O Indra, turn us not away!

3.7.s: abʰi tvā pūrvapītaya indra stomebʰirāyavaḥ samīcīnāsa r̥bʰavaḥ samasvaranrudrā gr̥ṇanta pūrvyam
3.7.d: अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतय इन्द्र स्तोमेभिरायवः समीचीनास ऋभवः समस्वरन्रुद्रा गृणन्त पूर्व्यम्
3.7.e: We compass these like waters, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed. Here where the filter pours its stream, thy worshippers round thee, O Vritra-slayer, sit.

3.8.s: pra va indrāya br̥hate maruto brahmārcata vr̥tram̐ hanati vr̥trahā śatakraturvajreṇa śataparvaṇā
3.8.d: प्र व इन्द्राय बृहते मरुतो ब्रह्मार्चत वृत्रꣳ हनति वृत्रहा शतक्रतुर्वज्रेण शतपर्वणा
3.8.e: All strength and valour that is found, Indra, in tribes of Nahushas, And all the splendid fame that the Five Tribes enjoy, bring, yea, all manly powers at once!

3.8.s: br̥hadindrāya gāyata maruto vr̥trahantamam yena jyotirajanayannr̥tāvr̥dʰo devaṃ devāya jāgr̥vi
3.8.d: बृहदिन्द्राय गायत मरुतो वृत्रहन्तमम् येन ज्योतिरजनयन्नृतावृधो देवं देवाय जागृवि
3.8.e: Yea, verily thou art a Bull, our guardian, rushing like a bull: Thou, mighty one, art celebrated as a Bull, famed as a Bull both near and far.

3.8.s: indra kratuṃ na ā bʰara pitā putrebʰyo yatʰā śikṣā ṇo asminpuruhūta yāmani jīvā jyotiraśīmahi
3.8.d: इन्द्र क्रतुं न आ भर पिता पुत्रेभ्यो यथा शिक्षा णो अस्मिन्पुरुहूत यामनि जीवा ज्योतिरशीमहि
3.8.e: Whether, O Sakra, thou be far, or, Vritra-slayer, near at hand, Thence by heaven-reaching songs he who bath pressed the juice invites thee with thy long-maned steeds.

3.8.s: mā na indra parā vr̥ṇagbʰavā naḥ sadʰamādye tvaṃ na ūtī tvaminna āpyam mā na indra parā vr̥ṇak
3.8.d: मा न इन्द्र परा वृणग्भवा नः सधमाद्ये त्वं न ऊती त्वमिन्न आप्यम् मा न इन्द्र परा वृणक्
3.8.e: In the wild raptures of the juice sing to your hero with high laud, to him the wise, To Indra glorious in his name, the mighty one, even as the hymn alloweth it!

3.8.s: vayaṃ gʰa tvā sutāvanta āpo na vr̥ktabarhiṣaḥ pavitrasya prasravaṇeṣu vr̥trahanpari stotāra āsate
3.8.d: वयं घ त्वा सुतावन्त आपो न वृक्तबर्हिषः पवित्रस्य प्रस्रवणेषु वृत्रहन्परि स्तोतार आसते
3.8.e: O Indra, give us for our weal a triple refuge, triply strong! Bestow a dwelling-place on our rich lords and me, and keep thy dart afar from these!

3.8.s: yadindra nāhuṣīṣvā ojo nr̥mṇaṃ ca kr̥ṣṭiṣu yadvā pañca kṣitīnāṃ dyumnamā bʰara satrā viśvāni paum̐syā
3.8.d: यदिन्द्र नाहुषीष्वा ओजो नृम्णं च कृष्टिषु यद्वा पञ्च क्षितीनां द्युम्नमा भर सत्रा विश्वानि पौꣳस्या
3.8.e: Turning, as 'twere, to meet the Sun enjoy from Indra all good things! When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.

3.8.s: satyamittʰā vr̥ṣedasi vr̥ṣajūtirno 'vitā vr̥ṣā hyugra śr̥ṇviṣe parāvati vr̥ṣo arvāvati śrutaḥ
3.8.d: सत्यमित्था वृषेदसि वृषजूतिर्नो ऽविता वृषा ह्युग्र शृण्विषे परावति वृषो अर्वावति श्रुतः
3.8.e: The godless mortal gaineth not this food, O thou whose life is long! But one who yokes the bright-hued horses, Etasas; then Indra yokes his tawny steeds.

3.8.s: yaccʰakrāsi parāvati yadarvāvati vr̥trahan atastvā gīrbʰirdyugadindra keśibʰiḥ sutāvām̐ ā vivāsati
3.8.d: यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वृत्रहन् अतस्त्वा गीर्भिर्द्युगदिन्द्र केशिभिः सुतावाꣳ आ विवासति
3.8.e: Draw near unto our Indra who must be invoked in every fight! Come, thou most mighty Vritra-slayer, meet for praise, come to, libations and to hymns!

3.8.s: abʰi vo vīramandʰaso madeṣu gāya girā mahā vicetasam indraṃ nāma śrutyam̐ śākinaṃ vaco yatʰā
3.8.d: अभि वो वीरमन्धसो मदेषु गाय गिरा महा विचेतसम् इन्द्रं नाम श्रुत्यꣳ शाकिनं वचो यथा
3.8.e: Thine, Indra, is the lowest wealth, thou cherishest the midmost wealth, Thou ever rulest all the highest: in the fray for cattle none resisteth thee.

3.8.s: indra tridʰātu śaraṇaṃ trivarūtʰam̐ svastaye cʰardiryaccʰa magʰavadbʰyaśca mahyaṃ ca yāvayā didyumebʰyaḥ
3.8.d: इन्द्र त्रिधातु शरणं त्रिवरूथꣳ स्वस्तये छर्दिर्यच्छ मघवद्भ्यश्च मह्यं च यावया दिद्युमेभ्यः
3.8.e: Where art thou? Whither art thou gone? For many a place attracts thy mind. Haste, warrior, fort-destroyer, Lord of battle's din! haste, holy songs have sounded forth!

3.9.s: śrāyanta iva sūryaṃ viśvedindrasya bʰakṣata vasūni jāto janimānyojasā prati bʰāgaṃ na dīdʰimaḥ
3.9.d: श्रायन्त इव सूर्यं विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य भक्षत वसूनि जातो जनिमान्योजसा प्रति भागं न दीधिमः
3.9.e: Here, verily, yesterday we let the thunder-wielder drink his fill. Bring him the juice poured forth in sacrifice to-day. Now range you by the glorious one!

3.9.s: na sīmadeva āpa tadiṣaṃ dīrgʰāyo martyaḥ etagvā cidyā etaśo yuyojata indro harī yuyojate
3.9.d: न सीमदेव आप तदिषं दीर्घायो मर्त्यः एतग्वा चिद्या एतशो युयोजत इन्द्रो हरी युयोजते
3.9.e: He who as sovran Lord of men moves with his chariots unrestrained, The Vritra-slayer, vanquisher of fighting hosts, pre-eminent, is praised in song.

3.9.s: ā no viśvāsu havyamindram̐ samatsu bʰūṣata upa brahmāṇi savanāni vr̥trahanparamajyā r̥cīṣama
3.9.d: आ नो विश्वासु हव्यमिन्द्रꣳ समत्सु भूषत उप ब्रह्माणि सवनानि वृत्रहन्परमज्या ऋचीषम
3.9.e: Indra, give us security from that whereof we are afraid Help us, O Maghavan, let thy favour aid us thus; drive away foes and enemies!

3.9.s: tavedindrāvamaṃ vasu tvaṃ puṣyasi madʰyamam satrā viśvasya paramasya rājasi na kiṣṭvā goṣu vr̥ṇvate
3.9.d: तवेदिन्द्रावमं वसु त्वं पुष्यसि मध्यमम् सत्रा विश्वस्य परमस्य राजसि न किष्ट्वा गोषु वृण्वते
3.9.e: Strong pillar thou, Lord of the home! armour of Soma-offerers! The drop of Soma breaketh all the strongholds down, and Indra is the Rishis' friend.

3.9.s: kveyatʰa kvedasi purutrā ciddʰi te manaḥ alarṣi yudʰma kʰajakr̥tpurandara pra gāyatrā agāsiṣuḥ
3.9.d: क्वेयथ क्वेदसि पुरुत्रा चिद्धि ते मनः अलर्षि युध्म खजकृत्पुरन्दर प्र गायत्रा अगासिषुः
3.9.e: Verily, Surya, thou art great; truly, Aditya, thou art great! O most admired for greatness of thy majesty, God, by thy greatness thou art great!

3.9.s: vayamenamidā hyopīpemeha vajriṇam tasmā u adya savane sutaṃ bʰarā nūnaṃ bʰūṣata śrute
3.9.d: वयमेनमिदा ह्योपीपेमेह वज्रिणम् तस्मा उ अद्य सवने सुतं भरा नूनं भूषत श्रुते
3.9.e: Indra! thy friend, when fair of form and rich in chariots, steeds, and kine, Hath ever vital power that gives him strength, and joins the company with radiant men.

3.9.s: yo rājā carṣaṇīnāṃ yātā ratʰebʰiradʰriguḥ viśvāsāṃ tarutā pr̥tanānāṃ jyeṣṭʰaṃ yo vr̥trahā gr̥ṇe
3.9.d: यो राजा चर्षणीनां याता रथेभिरध्रिगुः विश्वासां तरुता पृतनानां ज्येष्ठं यो वृत्रहा गृणे
3.9.e: O Indra, if a hundred heavens and if a hundred earths were thine,-- No, not a hundred suns could match thee at thy birth, not both the worlds, O Thunderer!

3.9.s: yata indra bʰayāmahe tato no abʰayaṃ kr̥dʰi magʰavañcʰagdʰi tava tanna ūtaye vi dviṣo vi mr̥dʰo jahi
3.9.d: यत इन्द्र भयामहे ततो नो अभयं कृधि मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतये वि द्विषो वि मृधो जहि
3.9.e: Though, Indra, thou art called by men eastward and west ward, north and south, Thou chiefly art with Anava and Turvasa, brave champion urged by men to come.

3.9.s: vāstoṣpate dʰruvā stʰūṇām̐ satram̐ somyānām drapsaḥ purāṃ bʰettā śaśvatīnāmindro munīnām̐ sakʰā
3.9.d: वास्तोष्पते ध्रुवा स्थूणाꣳ सत्रꣳ सोम्यानाम् द्रप्सः पुरां भेत्ता शश्वतीनामिन्द्रो मुनीनाꣳ सखा
3.9.e: Indra whose wealth is in thyself, what mortal will attack this man? The strong will win the spoil on the decisive day through faith in thee, O Maghavan!

3.9.s: baṇmahām̐ asi sūrya baḍāditya mahām̐ asi mahaste sato mahimā paniṣṭama mahnā deva mahām̐ asi
3.9.d: बण्महाꣳ असि सूर्य बडादित्य महाꣳ असि महस्ते सतो महिमा पनिष्टम मह्ना देव महाꣳ असि
3.9.e: First, Indra! Agni! hath this Maid come footless unto those with feet. Stretching her head and speaking loudly with her tongue, she hath gone downward thirty steps.

3.10.s: aśvī ratʰī surūpa idgomām̐ yadindra te sakʰā śvātrabʰājā vayasā sacate sadā candrairyāti sabʰāmupa
3.10.d: अश्वी रथी सुरूप इद्गोमाꣳ यदिन्द्र ते सखा श्वात्रभाजा वयसा सचते सदा चन्द्रैर्याति सभामुप
