8.2.d: अभि द्रोणानि बभ्रवः शुक्रा ऋतस्य धारया वाजं गोमन्तमक्षरन्
8.2.e: Mitra of holy strength I call, and foe-destroying Varuna, Who perfect prayer with offered oil.

8.2.s: sutā indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbʰyaḥ somā arṣantu viṣṇave
8.2.d: सुता इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः सोमा अर्षन्तु विष्णवे
8.2.e: By Law, O Mitra, Varuna, Law-strengtheners who cleave to Law, Have ye obtained your lofty power.

8.2.s: pra soma devavītaye sindʰurna pipye arṇasā am̐śoḥ payasā madiro na jāgr̥viraccʰā kośaṃ madʰuścutam
8.2.d: प्र सोम देववीतये सिन्धुर्न पिप्ये अर्णसा अꣳशोः पयसा मदिरो न जागृविरच्छा कोशं मधुश्चुतम्
8.2.e: The Sages, Mitra, Varuna, of wide dominion, mighty ones, Bestow on us effectual strength. VII Maruts

8.2.s: ā haryato arjuno atke avyata priyaḥ sūnurna marjyaḥ tamīm̐ hinvantyapaso yatʰā ratʰaṃ nadīṣvā gabʰastyoḥ
8.2.d: आ हर्यतो अर्जुनो अत्के अव्यत प्रियः सूनुर्न मर्ज्यः तमीꣳ हिन्वन्त्यपसो यथा रथं नदीष्वा गभस्त्योः
8.2.e: So mayst thou verily be seen coming with fearless Indra: both Of equal splendour, bringing bliss!

8.2.s: pra somāso madacyutaḥ śravase no magʰonām sutā vidatʰe akramuḥ
8.2.d: प्र सोमासो मदच्युतः श्रवसे नो मघोनाम् सुता विदथे अक्रमुः
8.2.e: Thereafter they, as is their wont, resumed the state of new-born babes, Taking their sacrificial name.

8.2.s: ādīm̐ ham̐so yatʰā gaṇaṃ viśvasyāvīvaśanmatim atyo na gobʰirajyate
8.2.d: आदीꣳ हꣳसो यथा गणं विश्वस्यावीवशन्मतिम् अत्यो न गोभिरज्यते
8.2.e: Thou, Indra, with the rapid Gods who shatter even what is firm, Even in the cave didst find the cows. VIII Indra-Agni

8.2.s: ādīṃ tritasya yoṣaṇo harim̐ hinvantyadribʰiḥ indumindrāya pītaye
8.2.d: आदीं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिꣳ हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये
8.2.e: I call the twain whose deed wrought here hath all been famed in ancient time: Indra and Agni harm us not!

8.2.s: ayā pavasva devayu rebʰanpavitraṃ paryeṣi viśvataḥ madʰordʰārā asr̥kṣata
8.2.d: अया पवस्व देवयु रेभन्पवित्रं पर्येषि विश्वतः मधोर्धारा असृक्षत
8.2.e: The strong, the scatterers of the foe, Indra and Agni we invoke: May they be kind to one like me:

8.2.s: pavate haryato harirati hvarām̐si ram̐hyā abʰyarṣa stotr̥bʰyo vīravadyaśaḥ
8.2.d: पवते हर्यतो हरिरति ह्वराꣳसि रꣳह्या अभ्यर्ष स्तोतृभ्यो वीरवद्यशः
8.2.e: Ye slay our Arya foes, O Lords of heroes, slay our Dasa foes: Ye drive all enemies away. IX Soma Pavamana.

8.2.s: pra sunvānāsyāndʰaso marto na vaṣṭa tadvacaḥ apa śvānamarādʰasam̐ hatā makʰaṃ na bʰr̥gavaḥ
8.2.d: प्र सुन्वानास्यान्धसो मर्तो न वष्ट तद्वचः अप श्वानमराधसꣳ हता मखं न भृगवः
8.2.e: The living drops of Soma juice pour, as they flow the gladdening drink, Intelligent drops above the station of the sea, exhilarating, dropping meath.

8.2.s: pavasva vāco agriyaḥ soma citrābʰirūtibʰiḥ abʰi viśvāni kāvyā
8.2.d: पवस्व वाचो अग्रियः सोम चित्राभिरूतिभिः अभि विश्वानि काव्या
8.2.e: May Pavamana, King and God, speed with his wave over the sea the lofty rite! Do thou by Mitra's and by Varuna's decree flow furthering the lofty rite:

8.2.s: tvam̐ samudriyā apo 'griyo vāca īrayan pavasva viśvacarṣaṇe
8.2.d: त्वꣳ समुद्रिया अपो ऽग्रियो वाच ईरयन् पवस्व विश्वचर्षणे
8.2.e: Far-seeing, lovely, guided by the men, the God whose habitation is the sea! X Soma Pavamana

8.2.s: tubʰyemā bʰuvanā kave mahimne soma tastʰire tubʰyaṃ dʰāvanti dʰenavaḥ
8.2.d: तुभ्येमा भुवना कवे महिम्ने सोम तस्थिरे तुभ्यं धावन्ति धेनवः
8.2.e: Three are the voices that the car-steed utters: he speaks the lore of prayer, the thought of Order. To the cows' master come the cows inquiring: the hymns with eager longing come to Soma.

8.2.s: pavasvendo vr̥ṣā sutaḥ kr̥dʰī no yaśaso jane viśvā apa dviṣo jahi
8.2.d: पवस्वेन्दो वृषा सुतः कृधी नो यशसो जने विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि
8.2.e: To Soma come the cows, the milch-kine longing, to Soma sages with their hymns inquiring. Soma, effused, is purified and lauded: our hymns and Trishtup songs unite in Soma.

8.2.s: yasya te sakʰye vayam̐ sāsahyāma pr̥tanyataḥ tavendo dyumna uttame
8.2.d: यस्य ते सख्ये वयꣳ सासह्याम पृतन्यतः तवेन्दो द्युम्न उत्तमे
8.2.e: Thus, Soma, as we pour thee into vessels, while thou art purified, flow for our welfare! Pass into Indra. with great joy and rapture: make the voice swell, and generate abundance! XI Indra

8.2.s: yā te bʰīmānyāyudʰā tigmāni santi dʰūrvaṇe rakṣā samasya no nidaḥ
8.2.d: या ते भीमान्यायुधा तिग्मानि सन्ति धूर्वणे रक्षा समस्य नो निदः
8.2.e: O Indra, if a hundred heavens and if a hundred earths were thine,-- No, not a hundred suns could match thee at thy birth, not both the worlds, O Thunderer.

8.2.s: vr̥ṣā soma dyumām̐ asi vr̥ṣā deva vr̥ṣavrataḥ vr̥ṣā dʰarmāṇi dadʰriṣe
8.2.d: वृषा सोम द्युमाꣳ असि वृषा देव वृषव्रतः वृषा धर्माणि दध्रिषे
8.2.e: Thou, hero, hast performed thy hero deeds with might, yea, all with strength, O strongest one. Maghavan, help us to a stable full of kine, O Thunderer, with wondrous aids! XII Indra

8.2.s: vr̥ṣṇaste vr̥ṣṇyam̐ śavo vr̥ṣā vanaṃ vr̥ṣā sutaḥ sa tvaṃ vr̥ṣanvr̥ṣedasi
8.2.d: वृष्णस्ते वृष्ण्यꣳ शवो वृषा वनं वृषा सुतः स त्वं वृषन्वृषेदसि
8.2.e: We compass thee like water, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed. Here where the filter pours its stream, thy worshippers round thee, O Vritra-slayer, sit.

8.2.s: aśvo na cakrado vr̥ṣā saṃ gā indo samarvataḥ vi no rāye duro vr̥dʰi
8.2.d: अश्वो न चक्रदो वृषा सं गा इन्दो समर्वतः वि नो राये दुरो वृधि
8.2.e: Men, Vasu! by the Soma with lauds call thee to the foremost place. When cometh he athirst unto the juice as home, O Indra, like a bellowing bull?

8.2.s: vr̥ṣā hyasi bʰānunā dyumantaṃ tvā havāmahe pavamāna svardr̥śam
8.2.d: वृषा ह्यसि भानुना द्युमन्तं त्वा हवामहे पवमान स्वर्दृशम्
8.2.e: O valiant hero, boldly win thousandfold spoil with Kanva's sons! O active Maghavan, with eager prayer we crave the yellowhued with store of kine. XIII Indra

8.2.s: yadadbʰiḥ pariśicyase marmr̥jyamāna āyubʰiḥ droṇe sadʰastʰamaśnuṣe
8.2.d: यदद्भिः परिशिच्यसे मर्मृज्यमान आयुभिः द्रोणे सधस्थमश्नुषे
8.2.e: With Plenty for his true ally the active man will gain the spoil. Your Indra, much-invoked, I bend with song, as bends a wright his wheel of solid wood.

8.2.s: ā pavasva suvīryaṃ mandamānaḥ svāyudʰa iho ṣvindavā gahi
8.2.d: आ पवस्व सुवीर्यं मन्दमानः स्वायुध इहो ष्विन्दवा गहि
8.2.e: They who bestow great riches love not paltry praise: wealth comes not to the niggard churl. Light is the task to give, O Maghavan, to one like me on the decisive day. XIV Soma Pavamana

8.2.s: pavamānasya te vayaṃ pavitramabʰyundataḥ sakʰitvamā vr̥ṇīmahe
8.2.d: पवमानस्य ते वयं पवित्रमभ्युन्दतः सखित्वमा वृणीमहे
8.2.e: Three several words are uttered: kine are lowing cows. who give the milk: The tawny-hued goes bellowing on.

8.2.s: ye te pavitramūrmayo 'bʰikṣaranti dʰārayā tebʰirnaḥ soma mr̥ḍaya
8.2.d: ये ते पवित्रमूर्मयो ऽभिक्षरन्ति धारया तेभिर्नः सोम मृडय
8.2.e: The young and sacred mothers of the holy rite have uttered praise, Embellishing the Child of Heaven.

8.2.s: sa naḥ punāna ā bʰara rayiṃ vīravatīmiṣam īśānaḥ soma viśvataḥ
8.2.d: स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं वीरवतीमिषम् ईशानः सोम विश्वतः
8.2.e: From every side, O Soma, for our profit, pour thou forth four seas. Filled full of riches thousandfold! XV Soma Pavamana

8.2.s: agniṃ dūtaṃ vr̥ṇīmahe hotāraṃ viśvavedasam asya yajñasya sukratum
8.2.d: अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसम् अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम्
8.2.e: The Somas, very rich in sweets, for which the sieve is distined, flow Effused, the source of Indra's joy: may you strong juices reach the Gods!

8.2.s: agnimagnim̐ havīmabʰiḥ sadā havanta viśpatim havyavāhaṃ purupriyam
8.2.d: अग्निमग्निꣳ हवीमभिः सदा हवन्त विश्पतिम् हव्यवाहं पुरुप्रियम्
8.2.e: Indu flows on for Indra's sake,-thus have the deities declared. The Lord of Speech exerts himself, controller of all power and might.

8.2.s: agne devām̐ ihā vaha jajñāno vr̥ktabarhiṣe asi hotā na īḍyaḥ
8.2.d: अग्ने देवाꣳ इहा वह जज्ञानो वृक्तबर्हिषे असि होता न ईड्यः
8.2.e: Inciter of the voice of song, with thousand streams the ocean flows. Even Soma, Lord of opulence, the friend of Indra, day by day. XVI Soma Pavamana

8.2.s: mitraṃ vayam̐ havāmahe varuṇam̐ somapītaye yā jātā pūtadakṣasā
8.2.d: मित्रं वयꣳ हवामहे वरुणꣳ सोमपीतये या जाता पूतदक्षसा
8.2.e: SPREAD is thy cleansing filter, Brahmanaspati: as prince thou enterest its limbs from every side. The raw; whose mass bath not been heated. gains not this: they only which are dressed, which bear, attain to it.

8.2.s: r̥tena yāvr̥tāvr̥dʰāvr̥tasya jyotiṣaspatī tā mitrāvaruṇā huve
8.2.d: ऋतेन यावृतावृधावृतस्य ज्योतिषस्पती ता मित्रावरुणा हुवे
8.2.e: High in the seat of heaven is placed the scorcher's sieve: its, threads are standing separate, glittering with light. The swift ones favour him who purifieth this: with brilliancy they mount up to the height of heaven.

8.2.s: varuṇaḥ prāvitā bʰuvanmitro viśvābʰirūtibʰiḥ karatāṃ naḥ surādʰasaḥ
8.2.d: वरुणः प्राविता भुवन्मित्रो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः करतां नः सुराधसः
8.2.e: The foremost spotted Steer bath made the Mornings shine: he bellows, fain for war, among created things. By his high wisdom have the mighty Sages wrought: the Fathers who behold mankind laid down the germ. XVII Agni

8.2.s: indramidgātʰino br̥hadindramarkebʰirarkiṇaḥ indraṃ vāṇīranūṣata
8.2.d: इन्द्रमिद्गाथिनो बृहदिन्द्रमर्केभिरर्किणः इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषत
8.2.e: Sing forth to him, the holy, most munificent, sublime with his refulgent glow, To Agni, ye Upastutas

8.2.s: indra iddʰaryoḥ sacā sammiśla ā vacoyujā indro vajrī hiraṇyayaḥ
8.2.d: इन्द्र इद्धर्योः सचा सम्मिश्ल आ वचोयुजा इन्द्रो वज्री हिरण्ययः
8.2.e: Worshipped with gifts, enkindled, splendid, Maghavan shall win himself heroic fame: And will not his more plentiful benevolence come to us with abundant strength? XVIII Indra

8.2.s: indra vājeṣu no 'va sahasrapradʰaneṣu ca ugra ugrābʰirūtibʰiḥ
8.2.d: इन्द्र वाजेषु नो ऽव सहस्रप्रधनेषु च उग्र उग्राभिरूतिभिः
8.2.e: We sing this strong and wild delight of thine which conquers in the fray, Which, Caster of the Stone! gives room and shines like gold.

8.2.s: indro dīrdʰāya cakṣasa ā sūryam̐ rohayaddivi vi gobʰiradrimairayat
8.2.d: इन्द्रो दीर्धाय चक्षस आ सूर्यꣳ रोहयद्दिवि वि गोभिरद्रिमैरयत्
8.2.e: Wherewith thou foundest shining lights for Ayu and for Manu's sake: Now joying in this sacred grass thou bearnest forth.

8.2.s: indre agnā namo br̥hatsuvr̥ktimerayāmahe dʰiyā dʰenā avasyavaḥ
8.2.d: इन्द्रे अग्ना नमो बृहत्सुवृक्तिमेरयामहे धिया धेना अवस्यवः
8.2.e: This day too singers of the hymn praise, as of old, this might of thine: Win thou the waters every day, thralls of the strong! XIX Indra

8.2.s: tā hi śaśvanta īḍata ittʰā viprāsa ūtaye sabādʰo vājasātaye
8.2.d: ता हि शश्वन्त ईडत इत्था विप्रास ऊतये सबाधो वाजसातये
8.2.e: O Indra, hear Tirschi's call, the call of him who serveth thee. Satisfy him with wealth of kine and valient offspring! Great art thou.

8.2.s: tā vāṃ gīrbʰirvipanyuvaḥ prayasvanto havāmahe medʰasātā saniṣyavaḥ
8.2.d: ता वां गीर्भिर्विपन्युवः प्रयस्वन्तो हवामहे मेधसाता सनिष्यवः
8.2.e: For he, O Indra, hath produced for thee the newest gladdening song, A hymn that springs from careful drop thought, ancient and full of sacred truth.
